glossary.aisunqun: aisu- — to come; participle in -nqun, 'the ones coming' [來的每]
glossary.aisuqu-ji: aisu- — to come, to approach; imperfective participle -qu with accusative -ji, 'the coming (of them)' [來的行]
glossary.ažiγ̇ai: a- — to be; past ažiγ̇ai, 'there was' [有來]
glossary.ažuγ̇u: a- — to be; past ažuγ̇u, 'there was, he was' [有來]
glossary.aγtastu: aγta — gelding; plural -s plus -tu 'having', 'having geldings' [騸馬每有的]
glossary.aγ̇užam-boroγ̇ul-un: Aγ̇užam-Boroγ̇ul — Aqujam-Boroqul; genitive -un after a consonant [人名的]
glossary.batačiγan: Batačiγan — Batachiqan, son of Börte Chino [人名, 'a personal name']
glossary.bijü: bü- — to be; present bijü, 'there is' [有]
glossary.boro: Boro — Boro, a horse's name (boro 'grey') [馬名] · also 'blue-grey, grey', a colour (here of a cloak: boro örmüge-ben, 'one's own blue-grey cloak'; Ming 靑 'blue-green')
glossary.boržigidai-mergen: Boržigidai-Mergen — Borjigidai the Marksman; the Borjigin clan takes its name from him [兒名]
glossary.burqan-qaldun: Burqan-Qaldun — the holy mountain of the Mongols [山名]
glossary.böleg: böleg — a group, a body, a band of people [叢]
glossary.börte: börte — blue-grey, the grey of a wolf's coat; also the ancestor's name Börte [蒼色] · also the woman's name Börte (Temüjin's betrothed; Ming (女)名 'a woman's name')
glossary.böġesü: bü- — to be; conditional böġesü, 'if it be, if it is that' [有來] · also glossed 有呵, with 呵 the marker of 'if' (Ming 有來 or 有呵); with ele, 'if only … be'
glossary.büleġe: bü- — to be; past büleġe, 'there was, used to be' [有來]
glossary.dair: Dair — Dayir, a horse's name [馬名]
glossary.deġere: deġere — above, upper, on top [上] · also (Ming 一面 'one side, besides') after amaraγ: amaraγ deġere dabqur amaraγ, 'close, and besides, doubly close' (uncertain) · also 'besides, in addition' after an adjective (Ming 上), as in čüġen deġere, 'besides being few'
glossary.deġereče: deġere — above, top; ablative -če, 'from above, from the top' [上自]
glossary.deġü-deġen: deġü — younger brother; dative-locative with reflexive-possessive, 'to his own younger brother' [弟自的行]
glossary.deġü-jüġen: deġü — younger brother; accusative with reflexive-possessive, 'his own younger brother' [弟自的行]
glossary.deġü-lüġe-beġen: deġü — younger brother; -lüġe 'together with' + -beġen reflexive-possessive: 'with his own younger brother' [弟一同自的]
glossary.dobün-mergen: Dobun-Mergen — Dobun the Marksman; spelled Dobün here, the same name [人名]
glossary.dunda: dunda — middle, in the middle of [中] · also 'half, part-way' (adverb, before a possessive: dunda keġelitei 'half-belly-having'; Ming 半孕 'half-pregnant')
glossary.duwa-soqor: Duwa-Soqor — Duwa the One-eyed (soqor 'blind, one-eyed') [兒名]
glossary.ese: ese — not (negates a past action; ülü negates present or future) [不曾] · before a converb: ese toγ̇aγdažu 'not yet counted' (as ese ögdegsen 'not given' in §6), where ülü is the usual negative of a converb
glossary.gergei: gergei — wife, the woman of a household [妻]
glossary.gergeitü: gergei — wife; with -tü 'having', so 'having a wife, married to' [妻有的]
glossary.huruγ̇u: huruγ̇u — downstream, following the course, along [順]
glossary.hužaγ̇ur: hužaγ̇ur — root, origin, the stock a line springs from [根源] · also 'end, tip' (Ming 尖 'point')
glossary.ilebe: ile- — to send; past -be, 'sent' [敎去了] · also where the Ming reads 去了 'went' (uncertain) [去了]
glossary.in-ü: in-ü — his, her, its (third-person genitive, placed after its noun) [他的]
glossary.irebe: ire- — to come; past -be, 'came' [來了] · also where the Ming has 去了 'went' (Boγ̇orču … urižu irebe, §95, 'came'; ire- means 'come', so the Ming 去了 is not translated)
glossary.irgen: irgen — people, the common folk of a camp or realm [百姓]
glossary.ketülžü: ketül- — to cross over (water); imperfective converb -žü, 'crossing' [渡着]
glossary.köġün: köġün — son [子] · also read as a collective, 'sons', before a list of several names (Menen-Tudun-(n)u köġün … doloγ̇an, 'seven'; the plural köġüd is the usual form) · also 'lad, young man' (Ming 後生 'junior'), as in köġün küġün 'a young man'
glossary.külüġüd: külüg — a swift, outstanding horse; plural -üd [駿, plural] · also külüg 'hero, outstanding man' (Ming 傑), plural -üd, 'heroes' (noun + plural; Ming 傑每)
glossary.maral: maral — hind, the female red deer [鹿]
glossary.maṅlai: maṅlai — forehead, brow [額] · also 'the vanguard, lead scouts' (Ming 頭哨), a further reading of the word for 'forehead' [頭哨]
glossary.monγolžin-toγ̇a: Monγolžin-Toγ̇a — Mongoljin-Qo'a (toγ̇a/γoγ̇a 'fair, comely') [婦人名, 'a woman's name']
glossary.na: -(n)a — dative-locative: at, in, to (back-vowel form) [行] · also a particle na (Ming 好生 'well, very'; sense uncertain), in bolγaqu na žöb, 'to be made, na, right' (§126) · also Waṅ-Qān-(n)a, 'to Wang Qan' (after a stem ending in n; the (n) is Shiratori's; Ming 人名行)
glossary.ne: -(n)e — dative-locative: at, in, to (front-vowel form) [行] · also on names, De-Sečen-(n)e and Höġelün-(n)e, 'to De-Sechen, to Högelün' (Ming 行), where the (n) is Shiratori's · also -(n)e after küġün (küġün-(n)e), the agent after a passive, 'by a person' (Ming 被人行) · also müren-(n)e, 'to the river' (müren ends in n; the (n) is Shiratori's; Ming 河 行)
glossary.neġürid: neġüri — one stage of a nomadic move, the ground covered between camps; plural -d [程, 'a stage of a journey']
glossary.neġüžü: neġü- — to move camp, to migrate; converb, 'moving camp' [起着]
glossary.nidütü: nidün — eye; with -tü 'having', 'having an eye' [眼有的]
glossary.nigen: nigen — one, a [一] · also 'together, as one' (Ming 一同) · also 'one, a' with Ming 一箇, before the thing counted
glossary.nu: -(n)u — genitive: of (back-vowel form; the n appears after a vowel-final stem) [的] · also printed after stems that already end in n (Menen-Tudun-(n)u, Qačin-(n)u, Qaγan-(n)u, Onan-(n)u), where the (n) is Shiratori's; the Ming 的 as elsewhere · also küġün-(n)u, 'of a person' · also printed after Waṅ-Qān-(n)u, 'of Wang Qan' (Ming 的), where the (n) is Shiratori's
glossary.nutuγlažu: nutuγla- — to camp, to occupy as pasture (from nutuγ, home ground); converb, 'camping' [營盤做着]
glossary.nü: -(n)ü — genitive: of (front-vowel form) [的] · also printed after an n-final stem (Tumbinai-Sečen-(n)ü) and after back-vowel names (Qabul-Qaγan-(n)ü), where the front-vowel form breaks harmony; the Ming 訥 writes -nu and -nü alike
glossary.onan: Onan — the Onon, the river of Chinggis's homeland [河名, 'name of a river']
glossary.orožu: oro- — to enter, to come in; converb [入着]
glossary.qaraqu: qara- — to look, to see; imperfective participle -qu [望見] · also 'looking' (Ming 看), a participle of looking, 'that looks'
glossary.qaraγ̇utai: qara — black; with -tai 'having' (the front-vowel twin of -tu), so 'black' [黑]
glossary.qojar: qojar — two; it follows the pair it counts [兩箇] · also before the thing counted: qojar sumu, 'two arrows' (Ming 兩隻 'two (arrows)')
glossary.qoričar-mergen: Qoričar-Mergen — Qorichar the Marksman (mergen 'good shot, wise') [兒名]
glossary.sali-qačaγ̇u-jin: Sali-Qačaγ̇u — Sali-Qachaqu; genitive -jin after a vowel [人名的]
glossary.tamača-jin: Tamača — Tamacha; genitive -jin after a vowel [人的]
glossary.tede: tede — those, they (plural of tere) [那的每]
glossary.tergen-ü: terge — cart, wagon; genitive, 'of the cart' [車的] · also read as tergen (the n-stem 'cart', as in tergen-dür) + genitive -ü, 'of the cart' (Ming 車 的)
glossary.teriġün-e: teriġün — head, source, beginning; here dative-locative, 'at the head of' [源行]
glossary.teṅgeri-eče: teṅgeri — Heaven, the sky as a power; here ablative -eče, 'from Heaven' [天處]
glossary.teṅgis: Teṅgis — the Tenggis, an inland sea or great lake [水名, 'name of a water']
glossary.töregsen: töre- — to be born; past participle -gsen, 'born, the one born' [生了的]
glossary.tüṅgelig: Tüṅgelig — the Tünggelig, a stream [水名]
glossary.ögdegsen: ög- — to give; passive -de- plus past participle -gsen, 'having been given' [與了的]
glossary.ölžige-de: ölžige — the front-board or forward seat of a cart; dative-locative [前行]
glossary.üdür: üdür — day [日] · also 'daytime, midday' (Ming 晝), in üdür düli naran 'the noon sun'
glossary.ügülerün: ügüle- — to speak, to say; converb -rün, 'saying' [說]
glossary.üžere: üže- — to see; purposive converb -re, 'in order to see' [看]
glossary.čima-da: či — thou; dative-locative čima-da, 'to thee, for thee' [你行]
glossary.čiṅgis: Čiṅgis — Chinggis, the title borne by Temüjin from 1206 [Ming gloss: 太祖名, 'the name of Taizu']
glossary.žajaγ̇atu: žajaγ̇a — destiny, fate allotted; here with -tu 'having', 'destined' [命有的]
glossary.žalaγ̇utu: žalaγ̇u — young man, retainer; with -tu 'having' [後生有的]
glossary.γarba: γar- — to go out, to go up; past -ba, 'went up' [上去了]
glossary.γažar-a: γažar — earth, ground, country; here dative-locative, 'over the land' [地行] · also 'in the land, in the country' (keġer γažar-a 'in the wild country'; Ming 裏 'in')
glossary.γoγ̇ai: γoγ̇ai — pale, wan, fallow; also the name Qo'ai [慘白色]
glossary.γujuja: γuju- — to ask for, to request; first-person volitional -ja, 'let me ask' [索]
glossary.irgen-dür: irgen-dür — among the people, in the folk (irgen 'people' + dative-locative -dür, front-vowel form) [百姓 裏]
glossary.kürüġesü: kürü- — to reach, arrive; conditional converb -ġesü, 'when/if arriving' (verb, converb) [到呵]
glossary.ünen-kü: ünen-kü — truly, true (ünen 'true' + -kü, adjectival ending, uncertain) [實 也]
glossary.γoγ̇a: γoγ̇a — beautiful, fair; also the name element Qo'a (adjective) [美] · also 'pale' (of a colour; Ming 慘白), against 'beautiful, fair' (Ming 美)
glossary.nere: nere — name (noun) [名] · also 'name, title, rank' (Ming 名分, 'rank'), as in Žaγ̇ud-quri nere, Waṅ nere, 'the title Ja'ud-quri, the title Wang', and čaotao nere, 'the rank of Chaotao'
glossary.jeketei: jeke-tei — great, having greatness (jeke 'great' + possessive -tei, front-vowel form) [大 有的]
glossary.alan-γoγ̇a: Alan-Γoγ̇a — Alan-Qo'a, a woman's name (personal name) [(女名)]
glossary.neretei: nere-tei — named, having a name (nere 'name' + possessive -tei) [名(有的)]
glossary.ber: ber — even, also (particle) [也] · also glossed Ming 裏 'in', where it may rather be the instrumental -ber, 'with' (uncertain)
glossary.ögteġei: ög- — to give; read as passive -te- plus past -ġei, 'was given'; uncertain, inferred (verb, passive past) [與]
glossary.köl-barγužin: Köl-Barγužin — Köl-Barqujin, a place name; what köl means is not known (place name) [地名]
glossary.tögüm-ün: Tögüm-ün — of Tögüm, 'hollow, low ground' per the Ming (name + genitive -ün, front-vowel form after a consonant) [窊的]
glossary.barγudai-mergen: Barγudai-Mergen — Barqudai the marksman, a man's name (personal name) [人名 的]
glossary.barγužin-γoγ̇a: Barγužin-Γoγ̇a — Barqujin-Qo'a, a woman's name (personal name) [女名]
glossary.ni: -(n)i — accusative, marks the object (e.g. ökin-(n)i 'the girl' as object); the Ming writes 行 (case suffix) [女 行] · also on names and on müren (Temüžin-(n)i, De-Sečen-(n)i, müren-(n)i), where the (n) is Shiratori's; in places topic-like, 'as for Temüjin' (Ming 行 or (行))
glossary.qori-tumad-un: Qori-Tumad-un — of the Qori-Tumad, a people (tribal name + genitive -un, back-vowel form after a consonant) [部落名(的)]
glossary.qorilartai-mergen: Qorilartai-Mergen — Qorilartai the marksman, a man's name (personal name) [人名 行]
glossary.ariγ-usun: Ariγ-Usun — Ariq-Usun, a place name (ariγ 'clean', usun 'water') (place name) [地名 行]
glossary.barγužin-γoγ̇ača: Barγužin-Γoγ̇a-ča — from Barqujin-Qo'a (name + ablative -ča; the full -ača/-eče occur elsewhere, and what governs the short form is unclear) [婦人名(自)]
glossary.tere: tere — that, that one; also 'he, she' (demonstrative and third-person pronoun; plural tede) [那般] · also with Ming 那 ('that'), before a noun: tere deleme üge
glossary.γažar-turi: γažar-tur(i) — in the land (γažar 'land' + dative-locative -tur, a variant of -dur; the (i) belongs to the reflexive -(i)jan that follows) [地 自的行]
glossary.jan: -(i)jan — reflexive-possessive, one's own (back-vowel form; the token left after γažar-tur(i)- and γažar(i)-) [地 自的行] · also after aqui-dur(i)- (a participle with dative-locative) · also after quruγ̇ud(i)-, 'one's own fingers' (a plural noun with the accusative i; Ming 指頭 自的行) · also after tergen-dur(i)- ('to one's own cart'), amin(i)- ('one's own life', accusative), γar-tur(i)- ('in one's own hand') and niγ̇ur-tur(i)- ('in one's own face'), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after oin-dur(i)- ('in one's own mind') and morin(i)- ('one's own horse', accusative), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after aγ̇ur(i)- ('one's own breath, rage'), botoγan(i)- ('one's own camel foal') and turγaγ̇ud(i)- ('one's own companions'), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also -(i)jan after kituγai-jar(i)- (instrumental, 'with one's own knife') · also after tuk(i)- ('one's own banner'), qurdun(i)- and dun(i)- ('one's own fast horse'), qujag(i)- ('one's own armour') and sumun(i)- ('one's own arrow'), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after bolulčaγsan(i)- (a past participle with the accusative, 'what they had done together, their own'; Ming 共 做了的 自的行) and after jor(i)- ('his own sounding arrowhead'; the Ming 自的 has no 行), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after Uruγ̇ud(i)- and Moṅγud(i)- (people names; Ming 一種 自的行), 'one's own Uruqud, one's own Mongqud' · also after amin-dur(i)- ('in one's own life'; dative-locative, the (i) being Shiratori's; Ming 性命 自的行) · also after ulus(i)- ('one's own people'), ulus-tur(i)- ('to one's own people') and deġel-qubčasun(i)- ('one's own robe and clothing'), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after qaγan-dur(i)- ('with one's own qahan'), and after alaγsan(i)- and daisurγaγsan(i)- (past participles with the accusative, 'what one had killed, what one had rebelled against'), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after qān(i)- ('one's own lord', accusative) and tus(i)- ('our own rightful lord'), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after sumud(i)- ('one's own arrows', plural noun with the Shiratori (i); Ming 箭(每) 自的行) · also after qos-tur(i)- ('in one's own house'; dative-locative, the (i) being Shiratori's; Ming 房子 自的行) · also after aγtas(i)- and aγtans(i)- ('one's own geldings'), baγ̇atud(i)- ('one's own warriors'), Žirgin(i)- ('one's own Jirgin') and qačar(i)- ('one's own cheek'), where the (i) is Shiratori's (Ming 自的行) · also after omog(i)- ('one's own bravery', Ming 勇 自的行) and qor(i)- ('one's own quiver', Ming 箭筒 自的行), where the (i) is Shiratori's
glossary.keremün: keremün — squirrel (the Ming's 靑鼠 'blue squirrel') (noun) [靑鼠]
glossary.göreġetei: göreġe-tei — having game (göreġe 'game, wild animals' + possessive -tei) [野物 有的]
glossary.γažari: γažar(i) — land, followed by the reflexive -(i)jan 'one's own'; the (i) is a linking vowel or perhaps the accusative -i, uncertain (noun + reflexive-possessive stem) [地 自的(行)] · also γažar(i)-jar, 'by way of the land', with the instrumental -jar following (Ming 地面 裏 / 地行)
glossary.qorilaldužu: qorila-ldu-žu — forbidding one another (qorila- 'forbid, restrain' + reciprocal -ldu- + converb -žu) [相禁約着]
glossary.maγ̇ulaldužu: maγ̇ula-ldu-žu — troubling one another (maγ̇ula- 'vex, treat ill', from maγ̇u 'bad', + reciprocal -ldu- + converb -žu) [煩惱着]
glossary.qorilar: Qorilar — the Qorilar, a clan name (clan name) [姓氏]
glossary.oboγtu: oboγ-tu — having a clan (oboγ 'clan, lineage' + possessive -tu, back-vowel form) [姓(有的)]
glossary.bolžu: bol- — to become; converb -žu, 'becoming' (verb, converb) [做着]
glossary.göreġesün: göreġesün — game, wild animals (noun) [野物] · also with Ming 獸 'beast'
glossary.görüġüli: görüġüli — catchable, able to be taken in the hunt; inner form unclear, uncertain (adjective) [可捕]
glossary.saitu: sai-tu — having good, fine (sai 'good' + possessive -tu, back-vowel form) [好有的]
glossary.keġen: keġe- — to say; keġen 'saying', the converb that closes a quotation (verb, converb) [麽道]
glossary.ežed: ežen — lord, master; plural ežed, 'masters' (noun + plural -d) [主每]
glossary.burqan-bosqaγsan: Burqan-Bosqaγsan — Burqan-Bosqaqsan, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.sinči-bajan: Sinči-Bajan — Sinchi-Bayan, a man's name (bajan 'rich') (personal name) [人名]
glossary.urjaṅqai-dur: Urjaṅqai-dur — among the Uriangqai (tribal name + dative-locative -dur, back-vowel form) [部落名 裏]
glossary.aisun: aisu- — to come, approach; ending -n, converb or participle, uncertain (verb) [來]
glossary.alan-γoγ̇a-ji: Alan-Γoγ̇a-ji — Alan-Qo'a as object (name + accusative -ji after a vowel) [(女名) 行]
glossary.tende: tende — there, then (from tere 'that'; locative adverb) [那裏]
glossary.γujužu: γuju- — to ask for, demand (here, a bride); converb -žu, 'asking for' (verb, converb) [索着]
glossary.abuγsan: ab- — to take, get (here, a wife); past participle -γsan, 'having taken, the one who took' (verb, participle) [要了的]
glossary.josun: josun — custom, reason, the right way (noun) [理]
glossary.teimü: teimü — so, thus, it is so (adverb) [那般]
glossary.dobün-mergen-dür: Dobün-Mergen-dür — to Dobun the marksman (name + dative-locative -dür, front-vowel form) [(人)名 行]
glossary.irežü: ire- — to come; converb -žü, 'coming' (verb, converb) [來着]
glossary.töreġülbi: töre- — to be born; causative -ġül- plus past -bi, 'caused to be born': bore, begot (verb, causative past) [生了]
glossary.bügünütei: Bügünütei — a son's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.belgünütei: Belgünütei — a son's name; the Ming gloss cannot be read (personal name) [人起]
glossary.nereten: nere-ten — having names, named (nere 'name' + plural possessive -ten) [名(有)的(每)]
glossary.dörben: dörben — four (numeral) [四] · also Dörben, a people (the word is 'four'; the Ming marks it 種(名)), also Dörben-(n)ü 'of the Dörben' [種(名)]
glossary.köġütü: köġü-tü — having sons (köġün 'son' + possessive -tü, front-vowel form) [子(有的)]
glossary.tedüi: tedüi — so much, so, thus (adverb) [那般] · also 'so, then, thereupon' (a sentence adverb; Ming 便 'at once') · also 'so much, like, as' after a genitive, the size comparison (Ming 般) · also a pronoun, 'those, so many' (Ming 那些 'those')
glossary.atala: a- — to be, remain; converb -tala, 'while, until' (verb, converb) [住間]
glossary.ügei: ügei — without, there is not (negative particle) [無]
glossary.boluba: bolu- — to become; past -ba, 'became' (verb, past tense) [做了]
glossary.boluγsan: bolu- — to become; past participle -γsan, 'the one who became, having become' (verb, participle) [做了 的]
glossary.köġüd: köġün — son; plural köġüd, 'sons' (noun + plural -d) [子每] · also 'lords, princes' in the address Taičiγud köġüd (Ming 大王每)
glossary.abaγa-juγ̇an: abaγa-juγ̇an — own paternal uncle (abaγa 'father's younger brother' + reflexive-possessive -juγ̇an; here 'their own') [叔叔(自的)行]
glossary.uruγ-a: uruγ-a — as kin, to the kin (uruγ 'kin, relatives, offspring' + dative -a) [親戚行] · also 'to the offspring' (Ming 子孫行), as in Uruγ-un uruγ-a kürtele 'down to the offspring of the offspring'
glossary.ülü: ülü — not (negates present or converb forms) [不] · also before participles (ülü boluqui, ülü ögteküi), 'not' · also before a bare stem (ülü buča 'does not conceal') and a converb (ülü jaγaran 'not hurrying')
glossary.bolγan: bol- — to become; causative -γa- plus -n, 'making, treating as'; converb (verb, causative converb) [做] · also Ming 審 'scrutinise', glossing the whole word; the reading stays 'making' (uncertain)
glossary.doramžilažu: doramžila- — to look down on, slight; converb -žu (verb, converb) [下覻着]
glossary.qaγačažu: qaγača- — to part from, separate from; converb -žu (verb, converb) [分離着]
glossary.gežü: ge- — to cast aside, abandon, per the Ming; possibly the 'say' verb keġe- in an idiom, uncertain; converb -žü (verb, converb) [撇着]
glossary.neġübe: neġü- — to move camp; past -be, 'moved camp' (verb, past tense) [起了]
glossary.oboγtan: oboγ-tan — having a clan (oboγ 'clan, lineage' + plural possessive -tan) [姓(有的)]
glossary.bolba: bol- — to become; past -ba, 'became' (verb, past tense) [做了]
glossary.teġün-ü: teġün-ü — of that, his, her (tere, stem teġün- before case endings, + genitive -ü, front-vowel form) [那的]
glossary.toqočaγ-ündür: Toqočaγ-Ündür — Toqochaq-Ündür, a hill (ündür 'high') (place name) [地名 山名]
glossary.göreġelere: göreġele- — to hunt; purposive converb -re, 'in order to hunt' (verb, converb) [捕獸]
glossary.urjaṅqadai: Urjaṅqadai — a man of the Uriangqai (Urjaṅqai + -dai, person of; the suffix uncertain) [部落名]
glossary.čüġe-buγu: čüġe-buγu — three-year-old deer (čüġe 'three years old' + buγu 'deer, stag') (noun phrase) [三歲 鹿]
glossary.alažu: ala- — to kill; converb -žu (verb, converb) [殺︀着]
glossary.abid: abid — entrails, innards (Ming 肚臟); read as abi, a stem inferred from the Ming, plus plural -d (noun) [肚臟]
glossary.širažu: šira- — to roast; converb -žu (verb, converb) [燒着]
glossary.bükü-ji: bü- — to be; participle -kü, 'the one who is' + accusative -ji (verb, participle + case) [有的]
glossary.žoluγažu: žoluγa- — to meet, come upon; converb -žu (verb, converb) [遇着]
glossary.sirolγada: širolγa- — to give roast (meat), apparently from šira- 'roast'; stem and ending -da uncertain, read as a request (verb) [燒(肉)與的]
glossary.kēžüġü: keġe- — to say (written kē- when contracted); past narrative -žüġü, 'said' (verb, past tense) [說了]
glossary.ögsü: ög- — to give; optative -sü, 'let it be given, I will give' (verb, optative) [與(呵)]
glossary.aγ̇ušigitu: aγ̇ušigi-tu — having lung (aγ̇ušigi 'lung' + possessive -tu, back-vowel form) [肺有的]
glossary.žildu: žildu — half the body cavity, half-carcass, per the Ming (noun) [半截腔子]
glossary.abču: ab- — to take; converb -ču, 'taking' (verb, converb) [要着]
glossary.čüġe-buγu-jin: čüġe-buγu-jin — of the three-year-old deer (čüġe-buγu + genitive -jin after a vowel) [三歲鹿 的]
glossary.miqa: miqa — meat; stem miqan before an ending (noun) [肉]
glossary.gübčin-i: gübčin-i — the whole, entire, as object (gübčin 'whole' + accusative -i after a consonant) [全行]
glossary.ögbe: ög- — to give; past -be, 'gave' (verb, past tense) [與了]
glossary.čüġe-buγu-ji: čüġe-buγu-ji — the three-year-old deer as object (čüġe-buγu + accusative -ji after a vowel) [三歲鹿 行]
glossary.ačižu: ači- — to carry as a load, pack; converb -žu (verb, converb) [駄着]
glossary.aisurun: aisu- — to come; converb of time -run, 'when coming' (verb, converb) [來時]
glossary.žaγ̇ura: žaγ̇ur-a — midway, in the middle (žaγ̇ur 'middle' + dative-locative -a, back-vowel form) [路間] · also 'among, between' (Ming 間), in žaba žaγ̇ura dürüžu, 'into the crevice' · also 'meanwhile, in the meantime' (Ming 其間)
glossary.jadaṅgi: jadaṅgi — poor, in want (from jada- 'be lacking') (adjective) [窮乏]
glossary.köġün-beġen: köġün-beġen — own son (köġün 'son' + reflexive-possessive -beġen; the possessor is the subject: 'his own', 'my own') [子 自的(行)]
glossary.kötölžü: kötöl- — to lead, draw along; converb -žü (verb, converb) [牽引着]
glossary.jabuqu-ji: jabu- — to walk, go; participle -qu 'the one who goes' + accusative -ji (verb, participle + case) [行(的行)]
glossary.žolγažu: žolγa- — to meet; converb -žu (verb, converb) [遇着]
glossary.či: či — you, thou (second-person singular pronoun) [你] · also (uncertain) a particle after a noun, 'as for, if' (Ming 呵), as in ger či oira bijü, not the pronoun 'you'
glossary.asaγasuγ̇asu: asaγa- — to ask; conditional converb -γ̇asu 'if/when'; the element -su- is unaccounted for, uncertain (verb, converb) [問呵]
glossary.bi: bi — I (first-person singular pronoun; the stems na-, nama-, min- before case endings) [我] · also 'is, exists' (verb, perhaps a short form of bü-, compare bijü; Ming 有)
glossary.maγ̇aliγ-bajaγ̇udai: Maγ̇aliγ-Bajaγ̇udai — Maqaliq-Bayaqudai, a clan name; the Ming glosses it 姓氏 'clan name' in one place and 人名 'personal name' in another, and it is the same name (clan name) [姓氏]
glossary.jadažu: jada- — to be in want, to lack; converb -žu (verb, converb) [窮乏着] · also jada- 'to be unable', converb -žu, 'being unable' (Ming 不得着, 不能着), as in köġüd(i)-jen gelin jadažu, 'unable to drive off'
glossary.jabumu: jabu- — to walk, go about; present -mu, 'goes, is going' (verb, present tense) [行有]
glossary.göre: göre — first half of göreġesün 'game', which the edition prints split across two entries (noun, split word) [野物]
glossary.ġesün-ü: -ġesün-ü — second half of the split göre-ġesün 'game', with genitive -ü, 'of game' (noun, split word + genitive) [的]
glossary.miqan-ača: miqan-ača — from the meat (miqa, stem miqan, + ablative -ača, back-vowel form) [肉裏]
glossary.na-da: na-da — to me (bi, stem na-, + dative-locative -da, back-vowel form) [我行]
glossary.ög: ög- — to give; the bare stem is the imperative, 'give!' (verb, imperative) [與]
glossary.üge-dür: üge-dür — in the word, in the speech (üge 'word' + dative-locative -dür, front-vowel form) [言語 裏] · also üge 'word, speech' + dative-locative -dür (Ming 言語 行)
glossary.oreġele: oreġele — one of a pair, a piece; form uncertain (noun/numeral) [一隻]
glossary.quγulžü: quγul- — to break off; converb -žü, 'breaking' (verb, converb) [折着]
glossary.ögčü: ög- — to give; converb -čü after a consonant, 'giving' (verb, converb) [與着]
glossary.abčiražü: abčira- — to bring along (ab- 'take' plus a second verb); form uncertain; converb -žü (verb, converb) [將(來)着]
glossary.ger: ger — house, tent, household (noun) [家] · also 'house, tent' (Ming 室)
glossary.žaružu: žaru- — to employ, use (a person); converb -žu (verb, converb) [使着]
glossary.aqu: a- — to dwell, stay; participle -qu, 'the one who stays' (verb, participle) [住] · also 'there is' (Ming 有; a- as 'be', not 'dwell')
glossary.dobun-mergen-i: Dobun-Mergen-i — Dobun the marksman as object (name + accusative -i) [(人名)行]
glossary.boluγsa: bolu- — to become; first part of the past participle -γsa(n), which the edition breaks across two entries (verb, split participle) [做了]
glossary.n-u: -n-u — last letter n of the split participle boluγsa-n plus genitive -u, completing boluγsan-(n)u (split ending, genitive) [的]
glossary.ügeiġüi: ügeiġüi — without, none; ügei with a redundant negative -ġüi, uncertain (negative particle) [無]
glossary.böġed: bü- — to be; ending -ġed, 'being so, even so', uncertain (verb, converb) [便] · also read as a particle of sequence, 'and then, thereupon' (Ming 便), as in süni böġed 'then in the night' · also (Ming 見有 'being, there being') 'being so'
glossary.buγu-qatagi: Buγu-Qatagi — Buqu-Qatagi, a son's name (personal name) [(兒)名]
glossary.buqatu-salži: Buqatu-Salži — Buqatu-Salji, a son's name (personal name) [(兒)名]
glossary.bodončar-muṅqaγ: Bodončar-Muṅqaγ — Bodonchar-Munqaq, a son's name; muṅqaγ is an epithet 'simple' (personal name) [(兒)名]
glossary.urida: urida — formerly, before, in front (adverb) [在前] · also 'first, beforehand' (Ming 先)
glossary.dobun-mergen-eče: Dobun-Mergen-eče — from Dobun the marksman (name + ablative -eče, front-vowel form) [(人名)處]
glossary.eke-jüġen: eke-jüġen — own mother (eke 'mother' + reflexive-possessive -jüġen; here 'their own') [娘 自的]
glossary.alan-γoγ̇a-jin: Alan-Γoγ̇a-jin — of Alan-Qo'a (name + genitive -jin after a vowel) [母名 的]
glossary.ečine: ečine — behind, at the back (adverb/postposition) [背處]
glossary.ügüleldürün: ügüle- — to speak; reciprocal -ldu- + converb of time -rün, 'while speaking together' (verb, converb) [共說]
glossary.bidan-u: bidan-u — of us, our (bida 'we, inclusive', stem bidan-, + genitive -u, back-vowel form) [咱的]
glossary.ujaγaja: ujaγaja — near kin of the same branch; form unclear, uncertain (noun) [房親]
glossary.ügelġüi: ügelġüi — without; spelling variant, perhaps a misprint, of ügeiġüi, uncertain (negative particle) [無]
glossary.böġetele: bü- — to be (böġe- before an ending); converb -tele, 'while, although' (verb, converb) [旣] · also bü- 'to be', converb -tele, 'while' (Ming 有間)
glossary.ede: ede — these (plural of ene) (demonstrative pronoun) [這(的每)]
glossary.teġün-ü-ġei: teġün-ü-ġei — his own, his (tere, stem teġün-, + genitive -ü + -ġei, which I take as 'belonging to'; uncertain) [他的]
glossary.bi-že: bü- — to be; stem bi- before -že, 'indeed is' (verb + assertion particle -že, 'indeed, surely') [有]
glossary.keleldüküi-ji: kele- — to speak; reciprocal -ldü-, participle -küi, accusative -ji, 'the speaking together' (verb, participle + case) [共說的行]
glossary.an-u: an-u — their (back-vowel companion of in-ü, third-person genitive placed after its noun) [他的]
glossary.uqažu: uqa- — to understand, perceive, find out; converb -žu (verb, converb) [覺着]
glossary.küṅsilemel: küṅsilemel — a word of unclear form; the Ming 臘 suggests 'winter-cured, preserved (meat)', uncertain (noun/adjective) [臘]
glossary.činažu: čina- — to boil; converb -žu (verb, converb) [煮︀着]
glossary.köġüdi: köġüd(i) — sons; the (i) is read as the accusative -i (the Ming marks 行) before the reflexive -(i)jen (köġün + plural -d) [子每(自的)行] · also köġüd(i)-jer-en, 'with one's own sons' (Ming 兒子(每)自的行), where the (i) is Shiratori's linking vowel before the instrumental -jer, as in tümed(i)-jer, not the accusative
glossary.jen: -(i)jen — reflexive-possessive, one's own (front-vowel form; the token left after köġüd(i)-; here 'her own') [子每(自的)行] · also after ger-tür(i)- (dative-locative), 'one's own home' · also after ökin(i)-, 'one's own daughter' · also after kekül(i)- ('one's own tuft'), šibülgel(i)- ('one's own braid') and nidün-dür(i)- ('in one's own eye'), and after the accusative in žeġüdün-(n)i-jen (token ni-jen) · also after bergen(i)- ('one's own sister-in-law') and deġü-ner(i)- ('one's own younger brothers'), where the (i) is Shiratori's accusative; also after köġün(i)- ('one's own son') and ökid(i)- ('one's own daughters') · also -(i)jen after esüg(i)- ('one's own ripe mare's milk') and after -dür(i)- ('to one's own', ulus irgen -dür(i)-jen) · also after emeġel(i)- ('one's own saddle') · also after hüker(i)- ('one's own ox'), güžüġün-dür(i)-, ebčeġün-dür(i)- ('at one's own neck, chest') and üge-dür(i)- ('in one's own word') · also after ösül(i)- ('one's own enmity'), ebür(i)- ('one's own bosom'), čeriġüd(i)- ('one's own troops') and deġel(i)- ('one's own robe') · also after üges-tür(i)- ('in one's own words'), nököd(i)- ('one's own companions'), helige-ber(i)- ('prone, lying', analysis uncertain) and plain tür(i)- ('in one's own') · also after čerig(i)- ('one's own troops') and eje-dür(i)- ('in one's own counsel', eje uncertain), the token left being jen · also after geġüd(i)- ('one's own mares', stem uncertain) and öġer(i)- ('one's own self', Ming 自己 自), the token left being jen
glossary.žergelen: žergelen — in a row (žerge 'row, rank' + -len, adverbial, uncertain) [列]
glossary.saγ̇ulžu: saγ̇ul- — to seat, make sit; converb -žu (verb, converb) [坐着]
glossary.nižiġed: nižiġed — one each, one apiece; form uncertain (distributive numeral) [每一隻]
glossary.müsüd: müsü — arrow shaft; plural müsüd (noun + plural -d) [箭榦(每)]
glossary.quγuludqun: quγul- — to break; imperative(-optative) -(u)dqun, 'do break' (the Ming adds 您 'you'); the inner -ud- is unexplained (verb, imperative) [折折您]
glossary.nižiġed-i: nižiġed-i — one each as object (nižiġed + accusative -i) [一隻行]
glossary.jaγ̇u: jaγ̇u — what, how (interrogative) [怎] · also 'what' (Ming 甚), in jaγ̇u keġeldüleġei 'what we said together' · also 'anything', with ber … ese (Ming 甚麽), jaγ̇u ber … ese 'not anything'
glossary.baiγ̇ulqun: bai- — to stand, be; causative -γul- + imperative-optative -qun, 'let it stand, stop' (verb, imperative) [敎停住]
glossary.quγučižu: quγul- — to break; -či- 'each, one by one', uncertain; converb -žu (verb, converb) [各折折着]
glossary.oγ̇orba: oγ̇or- — to go off, depart; stem unknown, Ming 去了 may also mean 'done', uncertain; past -ba (verb, past tense) [去了] · also oγ̇or- 'to let fly, send off' (Ming 放了 'let go', of a hawk or bird); past -ba
glossary.qamtu: qamtu — together, jointly (adverb) [一同] · also glossed Ming 一箇 'one' ('together' remains the reading; sense uncertain)
glossary.čuγlažu: čuγla- — to gather up, bundle; converb -žu (verb, converb) [束着]
glossary.kēžü: keġe- — to say (written kē- when contracted); converb -žü, 'saying' (verb, converb) [說着]
glossary.tabuγ̇ula: tabun-γ̇ula — all five together (tabun 'five' + -γ̇ula 'all together, the whole lot') [五箇]
glossary.čuγtai: čuγ-tai — bundled, having a bundle (čuγ 'bundle' + possessive -tai, back-vowel form) [束的]
glossary.küġüleldün: küġüleldün — each man, one by one; form uncertain (distributive) [每人]
glossary.barižu: bari- — to take hold of, grasp; converb -žu (verb, converb) [拿着]
glossary.bitüġülžü: bitüġül- — to take in turn (Ming 輪着); form uncertain; converb -žü (verb, converb) [輪着] · also 'taking round, parading' (Ming 敎徇着), the causative converb of §81's bitüġülün
glossary.quγuluu: quγul- — to break; converb -un, 'breaking'; printed quγuluu but the Han 侖 reads lun, so quγulun (verb, converb) [折折]
glossary.jadaba: jada- — to lack, be in want; also 'be unable' (Ming 不能了); past -ba (verb, past tense) [不能了]
glossary.ügülebi: ügüle- — to speak; past -bi, 'said' (verb, past tense) [說了]
glossary.ta: ta — you, plural polite (second-person plural pronoun; stem tan- before case endings) [(您)]
glossary.min-u: min-u — my, of me (bi, genitive stem min-, + -u, set after its noun) [我的]
glossary.nama-ji: nama-ji — me, as object (bi, stem nama-, + accusative -ji after a vowel) [我行]
glossary.köġüd-i: köġüd-i — the sons, as object (köġün + plural -d + accusative -i) [子每(行)] · also 'the princes' as object (Ming 大王每(行)), of the Činos princes
glossary.ken-ü: ken-ü — whose, of whom (ken 'who' + genitive -ü, front-vowel form) [誰的]
glossary.sereldün: sere- — to be wary, suspect; reciprocal -ldu- + converb -n, 'suspecting one another' (verb, converb) [疑的]
glossary.keleldümüi: kele- — to speak; reciprocal -ldu- + present -müi, 'speak together' (verb, present tense) [共說有]
glossary.sereküi: sere- — to suspect; participle -küi, 'the suspecting, suspicion' (verb, participle/noun of action) [疑的]
glossary.tan-u: tan-u — your (plural) (ta, stem tan-, + genitive -u) [您的]
glossary.žöb: žöb — right, correct, proper (adjective) [是] · also 'exactly, just', before tende 'just then' (Ming 正)
glossary.sünid: sün — night; plural sünid, 'nights' (noun + plural -d) [夜(每)] · also a clan name, the Sünid (Ming 一種(名) 'a kind of …'), perhaps the same word with the plural -d, but not the 'nights' (proper name)
glossary.büri: büri — each, every (distributive particle) [每] · also Büri, a man's name (personal name; Ming 人名) [人名]
glossary.ger-ün: ger-ün — of the tent, of the house (ger + genitive -ün, front-vowel form after a consonant) [房的]
glossary.erüge: erüge — smoke-hole, roof-window of the tent (Ming 天窗 'skylight') (noun) [天窗]
glossary.dotoγa-jin: dotoγa-jin — of the door-lintel, the upper edge of the doorway, per the Ming; uncertain (dotoγa + genitive -jin after a vowel) [門額 的]
glossary.gegeġer: gegeġe-r — in the light, by brightness (gegeġe 'light' + -r, instrumental or locative, uncertain) [明裏]
glossary.biližü: bili- — to stroke, rub; converb -žü, 'stroking' (verb, converb) [摩着]
glossary.keġeli-dür: keġeli-dür — into the belly (keġeli 'belly' + dative-locative -dür, front-vowel form) [肚皮 裏]
glossary.siṅgekü: siṅge- — to soak in, penetrate; participle -kü (verb, participle) [透]
glossary.γarurun: γar- — to go out; converb of time -urun, 'when going out' (verb, converb) [出時]
glossary.sara-jin: sara-jin — of the moon (sara 'moon' + genitive -jin after a vowel) [月 的]
glossary.kili-jer: kili-jer — by or in a ray (kili 'ray, beam', inferred from the Ming 透入光裏, + -jer instrumental or locative); uncertain [透入光裏]
glossary.noγai: noγai — dog (noun) [狗] · also with Ming 狗般 'dog-like', in noγai kerel kerežü, 'quarrelling like dogs' (the Ming adds 般 'like')
glossary.sičabalžažu: sičabalža- — to crawl, creep; converb -žu (verb, converb) [爬 着]
glossary.γarqu: γar- — to go out; participle -qu, 'the one who goes out' (verb, participle) [出]
glossary.deleme: deleme — rashly, hastily (adverb) [造次] · also 'loose, overflowing' (Ming 泛濫), an adjective before üge: tere deleme üge, 'that loose word'
glossary.ügüled: ügüle- — to speak; -d, a verb ending that goes with a plural subject (here ta 'you'), uncertain (verb) [說]
glossary.teġü-ber: teġü-ber — by that, therefore (tere, stem teġü-, + instrumental -ber) [爲那般]
glossary.uqaγ̇asu: uqa- — to understand; conditional converb -γ̇asu, 'if/when understanding' (verb, converb) [省呵]
glossary.temdeg: temdeg — sign, mark; the Ming reads it 'plain, clear' (noun) [明白]
glossary.teṅgiri-jin: teṅgiri-jin — of Heaven (teṅgeri 'Heaven, sky as a power' + genitive -jin after a vowel) [天 的]
glossary.bijü-že: bü- — to be; present bijü, 'there is' + assertion particle -že, 'indeed' (verb + particle) [有 也者︀]
glossary.teriġü: teriġü — head (teriġü + possessive -tü; printed teriġü,ü but the Han reads teriġütü, 'having a head, headed') [頭 (有的)] · also plain 'head' with no ending (noun; Ming 頭)
glossary.ü: -ü — second half of the printed teriġü,ü, i.e. the possessive -tü 'having' (part of 頭 (有的)); uncertain (split ending) [頭 (有的)] · also the question particle -ü after žöb(ü), 'is it right?' (Ming 是麽, 麽 marking a question)

glossary.amin: amin — life, breath (noun; Ming 性命) [性命]

glossary.busu: busu — other, not so (adjective; Ming 別 'other, another') [別]

glossary.qučildužu: qučil- — to round, wrap round; -du- 'together, mutually' + converb -žu, 'wrapping together' (verb, converb; Ming 裹 'wrap') [裹著︀]

glossary.dutaγ̇ažu: dutaγ̇a- — to flee, run away; converb -žu, 'fleeing' (verb, converb; Ming 走 'run') [走著︀]

glossary.höġelün-üžin-i: Höġelün-Üžin — Högelün-Üjin, a woman's name; accusative -i, as object (name + case; Ming 婦人名 行) [婦人名 行]
glossary.delbege-dēče: delbege — rein, halter (noun; Ming 韁索); ablative -dēče, 'from, by the rein' (front-vowel form with a long ē; Ming 處) [韁索 處]
glossary.kilikü: kilikü — shaft of a cart (noun; Ming 車轅) [車轅]

glossary.šibülgeli: šibülgel — braid, queue (reading uncertain; Ming 練椎, where 椎 is 'mallet'); the (i) is Shiratori's and belongs to the reflexive -(i)jen that follows as the token jen (noun) [練︀椎 自的行]

glossary.ebür-ġen: ebür — bosom, lap (noun; Ming 懷裏); reflexive-possessive -ġen, 'one's own bosom' (noun + reflexive-possessive, front-vowel form after r) [懷裏自的(行)]
glossary.uruγšida: uru- — front, forward (stem uncertain; Ming 前); directional -γšida, 'toward' (Ming 向): 'forward' (noun + directional) [向前]
glossary.qoinaγšida: qoina — behind, after; directional -γšida, 'toward' (Ming 向): 'backward' (noun + directional) [向後]
glossary.odumui: od- — to go; present -mui, 'goes' (verb, present; Ming 去有) [去有]

glossary.žubur: žubur — stream, valley, flat (reading uncertain; Ming 川 'stream, plain') [川]
glossary.daγ̇uristala: daγ̇uris- — to resound, ring out (perhaps from daγ̇u 'voice'; Ming 震動 'shake'); -tala 'while, so that' (verb + terminal converb) [震動]
glossary.daγ̇u-bar: daγ̇u — voice, sound (noun); instrumental -bar, 'with a voice, aloud' (noun + case; Ming 聲 + 裏) [聲 裏]
glossary.uilažu: uila- — to weep; converb -žu, 'weeping' (verb, converb; Ming 哭) [哭著︀]

glossary.dabaγ̇ad: daba — mountain pass, ridge (noun); plural -γ̇ad, 'passes' (noun + plural; Ming 嶺每) [嶺每]
glossary.olon: olon — many (adjective or quantifier; Ming 多) [多]
glossary.dababa: daba- — to cross a pass; past -ba, 'crossed' (verb, past tense; Ming 過了) [過了]
glossary.uiladaqu: uila- — to weep; participle -daqu, 'the one weeping' (verb, participle; Ming 哭的) [哭的]
glossary.usud: usun — water; plural -d, 'waters' (noun + plural; the Ming 水(每) marks the plural in brackets) [水(每)]

glossary.qailaγ̇asu: qaila- — to call out (stem uncertain; Ming 叫); conditional -γ̇asu, 'if (he) calls' (verb, conditional; back-vowel partner of -ġesü; Ming 呵) [叫呵]
glossary.qaraižu: qarai- — to look back (Ming 囘顧); converb -žu, 'looking back' (verb, converb) [囘顧著︀]

glossary.čima-ji: či — you; accusative -ji on the oblique stem čima-, 'you' as object (pronoun + case; Ming 你行) [你行]
glossary.qaibasu: qai- — to seek (stem uncertain; Ming 尋他踪 'seek his tracks'); conditional -basu, 'if (one) seeks' (verb, conditional; Ming 呵) [尋他踪呵]
glossary.qaγ̇uluγa: qaγ̇uluγa — road, way (noun; Ming 道路) · also 'ditch, channel' (Ming 路渠 'road-ditch'), where the road is cut into a channel; the two senses are the one word read by the Ming [道路] · also standing with no Ming gloss, where its meaning is unknown and the road / ditch sense is not assumed
glossary.oluqu: olu- — to get, find; participle -qu, 'finding' (verb, participle; Ming 得) [得]
glossary.simboli: simbo- — to be silent, keep quiet (Ming 禁聲 'forbid sound'; form uncertain); -li, imperative or optative (uncertain; Ming 勾了) [禁聲勾了]

glossary.abčiraγsan: abčira- — to bring along; past participle -γsan, 'the one who brought' (verb, past participle; Ming 將來了的) [將來了的]
glossary.qojar-i: qojar — two; accusative -i, 'the two' as object (numeral + case; Ming 兩箇行) [兩箇行]
glossary.iregseġer: ire- — to come; past participle -gsen + instrumental -ġer, 'because of the coming' (verb, participle + case; Ming 說來的上頭, 'on account of'; the Ming 說 is not translated) [說來的上頭]
glossary.monγol: Monγol — the Mongols, a people (the Ming glosses 達達 'Tatars', as in the published monγol-i) (name) [達達]
glossary.γorqonaγ: Γorqonaγ — Gorqonaq, a place (place name; Ming 地名) [地名]

glossary.qutula-ji: Qutula — Qutula, a man's name; accusative -ji after a vowel, 'Qutula' as object (name + case; Ming (人)名 行) [(人)名 行]
glossary.moṅγol-un: Monγol — the Mongols (the Ming glosses 達達 'Tatars'); genitive -un, 'of the Mongols' (name + case, back-vowel form; written with a dotted ṅ) [達達的]
glossary.žirγalaṅ: žirγalaṅ — joy, rejoicing (Ming 快活; a noun, or a converb in -n of a verb žirγala-; uncertain) [快活]

glossary.žirγaqu: žirγa- — to rejoice, be glad; participle -qu, 'rejoicing' (verb, participle; Ming 快活的) [快活的]
glossary.ergüġed: ergü- — to lift, raise, set up (Ming 立); converb -ġed, 'having raised' (verb, converb) [立了]
glossary.γorqonaγ-un: Γorqonaγ — Gorqonaq, a place; genitive -un, 'of Gorqonaq' (place name + case) [地名(的)]
glossary.saγlaγar: saγlaγar — thick, bushy, dense (Ming 鬔鬆 'shaggy'; word class uncertain) [鬔鬆]
glossary.modun: modun — tree, trees, wood (noun; Ming 樹) [樹]
glossary.horčin: horčin — around, round about, surroundings (Ming 周圍; word class uncertain: noun or postposition) [周圍] · also horči- 'to encircle', converb -n, 'surrounding' (Ming 圍; form uncertain), as in siγui-dur horčin sakižu

glossary.qadaγ̇an-taiši: Qadaγ̇an-Taiši — Qada'an-Taishi, a man's name (personal name; taiši 'prince') [(人)名]
glossary.tatar-un: Tatar — the Tatars, a people; genitive -un, 'of the Tatars' (name + case; Ming (種名)的) [(種名)的]
glossary.ködön-baraγa: Ködön-Baraγa — Ködön-Baraqa, a man's name (personal name) [(人)名]
glossary.žali-buqa: Žali-Buqa — Jali-Buqa, a man's name (personal name) [(人)名]

glossary.ösül: ösül — enmity, grievance, wrong (noun; Ming 仇); paired with ösün [仇]

glossary.deliġün-boldaγ-a: Deliġün-Boldaγ — Deligün-Boldaq, a place; dative-locative -a, 'at Deligün-Boldaq' (place name + case; Ming 地名(行)) [地名(行)]
glossary.büküi-dür: bü- — to be; participle -küi + dative-locative -dür, 'at the being, when being' (verb, participle + case; Ming 有時) [有時]

glossary.baraγ̇un: baraγ̇un — right (hand or side; adjective; Ming 右) [右]

glossary.nodun: nodun — blood clot (noun; Ming 血塊) [血塊]

glossary.temüžin-üge-ji: Temüžin-Üge — Temüjin-Üge, a man's name; accusative -ji after a vowel, as object (name + case; Ming (人名)行) [(人名)行]
glossary.abčiraγsan-dur: abčira- — to bring along; past participle -γsan + dative-locative -dur, 'at the bringing, when (he) brought' (verb, participle + case; Ming 將來 時) [將來 時]
glossary.temüžin: Temüžin — Temüjin, a boy's name (personal name; Ming (兒名)) [(兒名)]

glossary.žüči-qasar: Žüči-Qasar — Jüchi-Qasar, a son's name (personal name, one two-part name) [(兒)名]

glossary.sočidaγ̇u: sočida- — to be afraid (Ming 驚怕; stem inferred); -γ̇u, finite ending (uncertain) (verb) [驚怕]

glossary.qošiliγ-un: qošiliγ — tent, round tent; genitive -un, 'of a tent' (noun + genitive) [帳房 的]

glossary.umaγsan: una- — to fall (written umaγ- here); participle -γsan, 'that has fallen' (verb, past participle) [倒了的]
glossary.γarγ̇asu: γar- — to go out; conditional converb -γasu, 'if / when he went out' (verb, conditional) [出呵]

glossary.sumuči: sumu — arrow; agent-maker -či, 'arrow-maker, arrow-shaver' (noun + agent suffix) [削箭的]

glossary.qonoγ̇ulun: qono- — to spend the night; causative -γul- + converb -n, 'making stay the night, lodging' (verb, causative converb) [敎宿]
glossary.bitüġülün: bitü- — to take around, parade (stem uncertain); causative -ġül- + converb -n, 'making go round' (verb, causative converb) [徇着]
glossary.žun-u: žun — summer; genitive -u, 'of summer' (noun + genitive) [夏的]
glossary.teriġün: teriġün — head, first (noun) [頭] · also 'source' (Ming 源), of a river
glossary.žirγoγ̇an-a: žirγoγan — six; dative -a, 'on the sixth' (numeral + dative, a date marker) [六行]

glossary.qurimlaldužu: qurim — feast, banquet; verb-maker -la- + reciprocal -ldu- + converb -žu, 'feasting together' (noun + verb-maker + reciprocal + converb) [相筵會 着]
glossary.šingeġesü: šinge- — to set, sink (stem inferred from the Ming); conditional converb -ġesü, 'when it set' (verb, conditional) [落了呵]
glossary.tarqaba: tarqa- — to scatter, disperse; past -ba, 'dispersed' (verb, past) [散了]
glossary.qurim-un: qurim — feast, banquet; genitive -un, 'of the feast' (noun + genitive) [筵會的]
glossary.tarqaγ̇ulun: tarqa- — to scatter; causative -γul- + converb -n, 'sending off, dispersing' (verb, causative converb) [散敎了]
glossary.köġün-eče: köġün — son, lad, young man; ablative -eče, 'from the lad' (noun + ablative; the Ming writes 行) [幼小人行]
glossary.heki: heki — nape, back of the neck (noun) [頭項]
glossary.deledüġed: deledü- — to strike (stem inferred from the Ming); converb -ġed, 'having struck' (verb, converb) [打了]
glossary.kebteġesü: kebte- — to lie down; conditional converb -ġesü, 'if / when he lay' (verb, conditional) [臥着呵]
glossary.üžegdekü: üže- — to see; passive -gde- + participle -kü, 'that will be seen' (verb, passive participle) [被着見]
glossary.usun-u: usun — water; genitive -u, 'of the water' (noun + genitive) [水的]
glossary.qarki: qarki — channel, watercourse (noun; Ming 溜道, 'flowing way') [溜道]
glossary.gedergü: gedergü — face up, on the back (adverb or adjective) [仰]
glossary.kebtežü: kebte- — to lie down; converb -žü, 'lying' (verb, converb) [臥着]
glossary.buγaγ̇u-ban: buγaγu — cangue; reflexive-possessive -ban, 'his own cangue' (noun + reflexive-possessive) [枷 自的行]
glossary.urusγan: urus- — to flow; converb -n, perhaps with a causative -γa-, 'flowing, letting flow' (verb, converb; form uncertain) [流着]
glossary.ile: ile — openly, bare, uncovered (adverb) [露着] · also (uncertain) the imperative of ile- 'to send' (as in ilerün, ilebe), kelen kižü ile, 'send word' (Ming 救去 'rescue, go', which does not itself say 'send') · also the bare stem as an imperative, 'send!' glossary.kebtebe: kebte- — to lie down; past -be, 'lay' (verb, past) [臥了]
glossary.aldaγsan: alda- — to slip away, lose, escape; participle -γsan, 'that has slipped away' (verb, past participle) [脫了的]

glossary.tarqaγsad: tarqa- — to scatter; plural past participle -γsad, 'those who have dispersed' (verb, participle plural) [散了的(每)]
glossary.qurižu: quri- — to gather; converb -žu, 'gathering' (verb, converb) [聚着]
glossary.saraγ̇ur-a: saraγur — moonlight, bright moon (noun) + dative -a, 'in the moonlight' (noun + dative-locative) [月明裏]
glossary.bederebe: bedere- — to search through, search in a line (stem inferred from the Ming); past -be, 'searched' (verb, past) [排尋了]
glossary.qarki-dur: qarki — channel, watercourse; dative-locative -dur, 'in the channel' (noun + dative-locative) [溜道 裏]
glossary.süldüsün: Süldüsün — the Suldus, a clan name (Ming 種名, 'kind, breed'; the form is the clan's) [種名]
glossary.sorγan-šira: Sorγan-Šira — Sorqan-Shira, a man's name (Ming 人名) [人名]
glossary.daγ̇arižu: daγari- — to pass by, go past; converb -žu, 'passing by' (verb, converb) [經過] · also daγ̇ari- 'to strike against, collide' (Ming 撞着), converb -žu, 'colliding'
glossary.arγatu-jin: arγa — skill, talent (stem uncertain; the Ming says 才有, 'having talent'); possessive -tu 'having' + genitive -jin, 'of the gifted one' (noun + possessive + genitive) [才有(的) 的]
glossary.naitaγdan: naitaγda- — to be envious, to be jealous (stem inferred from the Ming); converb -n, 'being envious' (verb, converb) [嫉妒]
glossary.kü: kü — just, indeed (emphatic particle) [只] · also with the Ming 也 'also, too' (in Ede ber ... kü kürülčežü), the same emphatic force, 'indeed' (uncertain)
glossary.kebte: kebte- — to lie down; bare stem as imperative, 'lie!' (verb, imperative; form uncertain) [臥着]
glossary.žaγ̇aqu: žaγa- — to tell, report; participle -qu, 'that will tell' (verb, participle) [吿]
glossary.bedereje: bedere- — to search through; -je, first-person wish, 'let us search' (verb, hortative) [排尋]
glossary.keġeldüküi-dür: keġe- — to say; reciprocal -ldü- + participle -küi + dative-locative -dür, 'at the time of their saying together' (verb + reciprocal + participle + case suffix) [其說 時]
glossary.möri: mör — track, road (noun); the token left after a hyphen before (i) in mör(i)-er-en and mör(i)-jer, the (i) being Shiratori's linking vowel [路 自的行]

glossary.že-kü: že-kü — so be it, very well (two particles, že + kü; Ming 那般者) [那般者︀]
glossary.keġeldübe: keġe- — to say; reciprocal -ldü- + past -be, 'said together, agreed' (verb, reciprocal past) [共說了]
glossary.bederežü: bedere- — to search through; converb -žü, 'searching' (verb, converb) [排尋着]
glossary.ama-γ̇an: ama — mouth; reflexive-possessive -γan (after a vowel), 'one's own mouth' (noun + reflexive-possessive) [口(自的)行]
glossary.šidu-ban: šidu — tooth; reflexive-possessive -ban, 'one's own teeth' (noun + reflexive-possessive) [牙(自的)行]
glossary.bileġüden: bile- — to whet, grind (form uncertain); converb -ġüden, 'grinding' (verb, converb; ending uncertain) [磨着]
glossary.aisu: aisu- — to come (verb, stem; the ending is unclear, the Ming has 來有 'there is coming') [來有]
glossary.qadaγ̇uži-kü: qadaγuži- — to be careful, take care; -kü, an imperative or hortative ending (verb; form uncertain, the sense is the Ming's) [謹︀愼]
glossary.čaγaγ̇an: čaγaγan — white (adjective) [白] · also Čaγaγ̇an, a man's name (personal name; Ming 人名) [人名] · also in horse names (Merkidai-Čaγaγ̇an, Aman-Čaγaγ̇an-Keġer; Ming 馬名, 名), not 'white' or a man's name
glossary.olqun: ol- — to find, get; -qun, a future or question participle (verb, participle; form uncertain) [得]
glossary.bedereġed: bedere- — to search through; converb -ġed, 'having searched' (verb, converb) [排尋]
glossary.tarqažu: tarqa- — to scatter, disperse; converb -žu, 'dispersing' (verb, converb) [散着]
glossary.manaγar: manaγar — tomorrow, the next day (adverb) [明] · also 'next morning, early morning, this morning' (Ming 淸, 淸早 'clear, early')
glossary.čiγ̇ulžu: čiγul- — to gather, assemble; converb -žu, 'assembling' (verb, converb) [聚着]
glossary.erije: eri- — to seek; -je, first-person wish, 'let us seek' (verb, hortative) [咱尋]
glossary.buγaγ̇utu: buγaγu — cangue; possessive -tu, 'having a cangue, cangued' (noun + possessive) [枷有的]
glossary.edüi: edüi — so much, only this much (adverb; Ming 只這般) [只這般]
glossary.man-i: bida — we; the oblique stem man- + accusative -i, 'us' (pronoun, first-person plural exclusive + accusative) [俺行]
glossary.eke-ben: eke — mother; reflexive-possessive -ben, 'one's own mother' (noun + reflexive-possessive) [母 自的行]
glossary.užebe: üže- — to see; past -be, 'saw' (verb, past; spelled with u here) [見了]
glossary.üžegdeġesü: üže- — to see; passive -gde- + conditional -ġesü, 'if one is seen' (verb, passive conditional) [被見呵]

glossary.kelele: kele- — to speak, say; imperative -le, 'speak!' (verb, imperative, form uncertain; with bu, 'do not speak') [說]
glossary.an-i: an — them (third-person plural oblique stem, inferred); accusative -i (pronoun + accusative) [他每行]
glossary.dotora-ban: dotora — inside, within (noun or postposition); reflexive-possessive -ban, 'one's own inside, in one's heart' (adverb + reflexive-possessive) [內 自的行]
glossary.sedkižü: sedki- — to think; converb -žü, 'thinking' (verb, converb) [想着]
glossary.qonoγ̇ulqui-dur: qono- — to spend the night; causative -γul- + participle -qui + dative-locative -dur, 'at the time of lodging (someone)' (verb + causative + participle + case suffix) [宿的 時分]
glossary.sorγan-šira-jin: Sorγan-Šira — Sorqan-Shira, a man's name; genitive -jin (after a vowel), 'of Sorqan-Shira' (personal name + genitive) [人名 的]
glossary.qonobasu: qono- — to spend the night; conditional -basu, 'if / when he stayed the night' (verb, conditional) [宿呵]
glossary.čimbai: Čimbai — Chimbai, a boy's name (personal name) [(兒)名]
glossary.oro: oro — hollow of the chest, pit of the stomach (noun) [心窩] · also oro- 'to enter' (verb stem, before the split-off converb žu and in oroγad; Ming 入) · also oro 'place, seat, position' (noun; Ming 位子), as in oro-ban 'one's own place'
glossary.žirüge-ben: žirüge — heart; reflexive-possessive -ben, 'one's own heart' (noun + reflexive-possessive) [心(自的行)]
glossary.ebedčü: ebed- — to hurt, ache (stem inferred from the Ming 疼着); converb -čü, 'aching' (verb, converb) [疼着]
glossary.sularažu: sulara- — to loosen, slacken; converb -žu, 'slackening' (verb, converb) [鬆着]
glossary.qonoγ̇aγ̇ululai: qono- — to spend the night; causative -γaγul- + past -lai, 'had (him) lodge' (verb, causative past; both endings uncertain, the sense is the Ming's) [敎宿來]
glossary.žaγ̇an: žaγa- — to tell, report; converb -n, 'telling' (verb, converb) [吿]
glossary.nögčin: nögči- — to pass on, go past; converb -n, 'passing on' (verb, converb) [過去]
glossary.aburamu: abura- — to save, rescue; -mu, present or future, 'saves, will save' (verb, present; ending uncertain) [救]
glossary.sün: sün — fresh mare's milk (noun) [生馬妳子] · also 'milk' in general (Ming 乳), the mother's milk a foal sucks
glossary.tüsürüġed: tüsür- — to pour out; converb -ġed, 'having poured out' (verb, converb) [傾了]
glossary.esügi: esüge — ripe mare's milk, perhaps qumis (noun; Ming 熟 'ripe'); the token left before -jen in esüg(i)-jen, the (i) being Shiratori's linking vowel [熟馬妳子自的行]
glossary.süni-de: süni — night; -de, dative-locative, 'by night, through the night' (noun + dative-locative) [徹夜] · also with Ming 夜裏 行, 'by night'
glossary.čaitala: čai- — to dawn, grow bright (stem inferred from the Ming); -tala, 'until' (verb + terminal converb) [明到了]
glossary.bülekü: büle- — to churn, splash (stem inferred from the Ming 澎); participle -kü, 'churning' (verb, participle; form uncertain) [澎]
glossary.sonosču: sonos- — to hear, listen; converb -ču, 'hearing' (verb, converb) [聽着]
glossary.jabubasu: jabu- — to walk, go; conditional -basu, 'if / when he goes' (verb, conditional) [行呵]
glossary.büleġür-ün: büleġür — churner, one who churns (form uncertain); genitive -ün, 'of the churner' (noun + genitive) [澎的]
glossary.ese-ü: ese — not (negative of the past); -ü, a question particle (Ming 不曾 … 麽) (negative + particle) [不曾] · also ese-ü with the Ming 不曾 only and no 麽, so the question force is uncertain
glossary.kelelüġe: kele- — to speak; -lüġe, past (verb, past; form uncertain, Ming 說來麽) [說來麽]
glossary.šibaγ̇uqan-i: šibaγuqan — sparrow, little bird (noun); accusative -i, marks the object (noun + accusative) [雀兒行]

glossary.buta-dur: buta — thicket, bush; dative-locative -dur, 'in the thicket' (noun + dative-locative) [兒叢 裏]
glossary.qorγobasu: qorγo- — to drive in, chase in (stem uncertain); conditional -basu, 'if (it is) chased in' (verb, conditional) [趕入呵]
glossary.aburažuγ̇ui: abura- — to save, rescue; past ending -žuγui, 'has saved' (verb, past) [救了有(來)]
glossary.bidan-dur: bida — we (inclusive); stem extension -n + dative-locative -dur, 'to us' (pronoun + case suffix) [咱行] · also, with the Ming 俺行 (not only 咱行), 'to us'; the Ming alternates 俺 and 咱 for the same inclusive form
glossary.keġemü: keġe- — to say; present -mü, 'says' (verb, present) [說有]
glossary.ečige-jüġen: ečige — father; reflexive-possessive -jüġen, 'one's own father' (noun + reflexive-possessive) [父親 自的行]
glossary.čučalžu: čučal- — to take off, undo (stem inferred); converb -žu, 'undoing' (verb, converb) [卸了着]
glossary.γal-dur: γal — fire; dative-locative -dur, 'in the fire' (noun + dative-locative) [火 裏]
glossary.tüležü: tüle- — to burn; converb -žü, 'burning' (verb, converb) [燒着]
glossary.qoitu: qoitu — behind, the back part (noun or adverb) [後頭]
glossary.noṅγasutu: noṅγasu — wool, felt; possessive -tu, 'having wool, woolly' (noun + possessive) [毛 有的]
glossary.düi-ben: düi — younger sister; reflexive-possessive -ben, 'one's own younger sister' (noun + reflexive-possessive) [妹子自(的)行]
glossary.asaraγ̇ulba: asara- — to tidy, put away, store; causative -γul- + past -ba, 'had put away' (verb, causative past) [敎收拾了]
glossary.niγ̇uba: niγu- — to hide; past -ba, 'hid' (verb, past) [藏了]
glossary.öġer: öġer — own, ourselves (pronoun-like word; Ming 自家) [自家]
glossary.nüṅčileldüje: nüṅči- — to search; verb-maker -le- + reciprocal -ldü- + -je, first-person wish, 'let us search one another' (verb + verb-maker + reciprocal + hortative) [相搜尋咱]
glossary.nüṅčileldübe: nüṅči- — to search; verb-maker -le- + reciprocal -ldü- + past -be, 'searched one another' (verb + reciprocal past) [相搜尋了]
glossary.iseri-jin: iseri — bed, couch (noun); genitive -jin (after a vowel), 'of the bed' (noun + genitive) [床 的]
glossary.nüṅčižü: nüṅči- — to search; converb -žü, 'searching' (verb, converb) [搜着]
glossary.büküi: bü- — to be; participle -küi, 'that is' (verb, participle) [有的]
glossary.köl-dür: köl — foot, the foot end; dative-locative -dür, 'at the foot' (noun + dative-locative) [脚頭裏]
glossary.qalaγ̇un-a: qalaγun — hot; dative -a, 'in the hot' (adjective + dative-locative) [熱行]
glossary.noṅγ̇asun: noṅγasun — wool, felt (noun; a variant of noṅγasu) [毛]
glossary.daγ̇usqu: daγus- — to bear, endure, withstand (stem uncertain); participle -qu, 'that can bear' (verb, participle) [當的]
glossary.nünčiġülsün: nüṅči- — to search; agent ending -ġülsün (perhaps the causative -ġül- + -sun), 'one who searches' (verb + agent ending; uncertain) [搜的]
glossary.baγ̇užu: baγu- — to come down, descend; converb -žu, 'descending' (verb, converb) [下來着] · baγ̇u- also 'to dismount, to camp' (Ming 下), converb -žu 'dismounting, camping' [下着]
glossary.nüṅčiġül-i: nüṅčiġül — searcher, the searching one; accusative -i (noun + case; stem uncertain, Ming 搜的 'the searching') [搜的 行]
glossary.oduγsan-u: od- — to go; past participle -uγsan + genitive -u, 'of the one who has gone' (verb, participle + case) [去了的]
glossary.hünesü-ġer: hünesü — ash, ashes; -ġer instrumental, 'like, as' (noun + case; the 'like' sense, Ming 般, is uncertain) [灰般]
glossary.keisgen: keisgen — scraping, scraped off (Ming 刮 'scrape'; stem and ending uncertain) [刮] · also keisge- 'to scatter, blow away' (Ming (颺) 'blow'), converb -n, 'scattering', as in hünesü-ġer keisgen 'scattering like ashes'

glossary.uwas-merkid-ün: Uwas-Merkid — the Uwas Merkid, the Uwas clan of the Merkid; genitive -ün, 'of the Uwas Merkid' (clan name + case) [姓氏 種名 的]
glossary.dair-usun: Dair-Usun — Dair-Usun, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.qaγ̇ad-merkid-ün: Qaγ̇ad-Merkid — the Qa'at Merkid, the Qa'at clan of the Merkid; genitive -ün, 'of the Qa'at Merkid' (clan name + case) [姓氏 種名 的]
glossary.qaγ̇atai-darmala: Qaγ̇atai-Darmala — Qa'atai-Darmala, a man's name (personal name, one two-part name) [人名]
glossary.erten-ü: erten — former time, long ago; genitive -ü, 'of former times, former' (noun + case) [在先的]
glossary.čiledü-dāča: Čiledü — Chiledü, a man's name; ablative -dāča, 'from Chiledü' (name + case; long vowel, uncertain) [人名 自]
glossary.abtalaγ̇ai: ab- — to take; passive -da- (written -ta-) + ending -laγ̇ai (uncertain), 'was taken' (verb, passive; the Ming 被要子 is the only evidence) [被要子]
glossary.ösen: ösü- — to repay, to avenge (stem uncertain; Ming 報); ending -n (converb or participle, uncertain) (verb) [報] · also read with the stem as printed, öse- (not ösü-), 'to repay' (Ming 報), ending -n, converb or participle (uncertain); it runs parallel to hači-jan aburan · also with the Ming 讐 'enmity' against hačiran 報 'repay' (teġün-i ösen hačiran, together 讐報 'repaying enmity'); the stem is öse- as printed, and here the word may lean toward the noun ösül 'enmity' (uncertain)
glossary.iregsed: ire- — to come; participle -gsed, 'those who have come' (verb, past participle, plural) [來了]
glossary.emes-i: eme — woman; plural -s + accusative -i, 'the women (object)' (noun + plural + case) [婦人每(行)]
glossary.hači-jan: hači — enmity, vengeance, a feud; reflexive-possessive -(i)jan, 'one's own feud' (noun + reflexive-possessive, back-vowel form) [讐 自的行]
glossary.aburaba: abura- — to repay, to requite (Ming 報); past -ba, 'repaid' (verb, past tense) [報了]
glossary.keġel: keġe- — to say; -l- is the first half of the reciprocal -ldu-, split from dužu across a line break (token keġel-) (verb stem + extension) [共說]
glossary.dužu: -dužu — the second half of the reciprocal -ldu- + converb -žu, split from keġel- across a line break; together keġeldužu, 'saying to one another' (extension + converb) [着] · also split from saγ̇al- (the stem saγa- + -l-), together saγ̇al-dužu, 'milking together'
glossary.nača: -(n)ača — ablative: from (back-vowel form; the token left after Burqan-Qaldun-(n)-, 'from Burqan Qaldun') [山名 自] · also after Qaγan-(n)-, 'from the Qaγan' (ablative; the (n) is Shiratori's; the Ming 皇帝 行 writes 行, not 處) · also after Waṅ-Qān-(n)-, 'from Wang Qan' (Ming 處 'at the place of') · also after Qān-(n)- 'from the Qan' and Gür-Qān-(n)- 'from Gür-Qan' (ablative; Ming 處) [人名皇帝 處] · also after hodun-(n)-, comparative 'than' (ablative; Hodun-(n)ača olon γaltan, 'more fire-owners than the stars'; the Ming 星 行 marks the noun and does not gloss the ending) · also after Naiman-(n)-, 'from the Naiman' (ablative; Ming 種名 處) · also after marijan-(n)-, 'from the skin' (ablative; Ming 皮膚 行)
glossary.geid-türi: geid — homes (plural of ger); dative-locative -tür, 'to the homes'; the (i) is Shiratori's, the token before the reflexive -(i)jen (noun + case) [家裏每 自的行]
glossary.maγad: maγad — truly, really, firmly (Ming 實) (adverb) [實] · also with Ming 眞實 ('truly, really')
glossary.ažiraba: ažira- — to turn back, to go back (stem uncertain; Ming 囘去); past -ba, 'went back' (verb, past tense) [囘去了]
glossary.ažiraba-ju: ažira- — to turn back; past -ba + -ju (Ming 有 'is'; analysis uncertain) (verb, past + ending) [囘了 有]
glossary.büġčü-ü: büġ- — to lie hidden, to lie in ambush (stem inferred from the Ming 伏); -čü (converb or past, uncertain) + question particle -ü (Ming 麽) (verb + particle) [伏了]
glossary.amui: a- — to be; present -mui, 'is, there is' (verb, present tense) [有]
glossary.uqaγ̇uta: uqa- — to know, to find out; uqaγ̇uta, 'to scout, to find out' (Ming 察探; ending uncertain) (verb) [察探]
glossary.daγaγ̇ulžu: daγa- — to follow; causative -γ̇ul-, converb -žu, 'making follow, having them follow' (verb, causative converb) [隨着]
glossary.merkid-i: Merkid — the Merkid, a people; accusative -i, 'the Merkid (object)' (people name + case) [種名(行)]
glossary.küṅgeġülžü: küṅge- — to be far (stem inferred from the Ming 離遠); causative -ġül-, converb -žü, 'keeping far off' (verb, causative converb) [離遠着]
glossary.ečeġü-ben: ečeġü — breast, front of the chest (Ming 胸前); reflexive-possessive -ben, 'one's own breast' (noun + reflexive-possessive) [胸前 自的行]
glossary.möġeledčü: möġele- — to beat, to strike (stem inferred from the Ming 椎); converb -dčü, 'beating' (verb, converb; the d is unexplained) [椎着]
glossary.solanγa: solanγa — weasel (Ming 黃鼠狼 'yellow weasel') (noun) [黃鼠狼]
glossary.sonosqu-jin: sonos- — to hear, to listen; participle -qu + genitive -jin, 'of the hearing, of what is heard' (verb, participle + case) [聽 的]
glossary.ünen: ünen — ermine (Ming 銀鼠 'silver mouse') (noun) [銀鼠] · also 'truth, true' (adjective or noun; Ming 實 'real'), not the 'ermine' of other passages · also 'true, sincere' (Ming 眞誠)
glossary.üžekü-jin: üže- — to see; participle -kü + genitive -jin, 'of the seeing, of what is seen' (verb, participle + case) [見 的]
glossary.büdün: büdün — whole, entire, thick-bodied (Ming 本; sense uncertain) (adjective) [本]
glossary.beje-ġen: beje — body, person; reflexive-possessive -ġen, 'one's own body' (noun + reflexive-possessive, after a vowel stem) [身 自(的)行]
glossary.buruγ̇udun: buruγ̇u- — to hide, to slip away (stem inferred from the Ming 躱); ending -dun (converb, uncertain) (verb) [躱着]
glossary.bugija: bugija — hobble, a rope tying the horse's feet (Ming 韁繩絆蹄) (noun) [韁繩絆蹄]
glossary.buγu-jin: buγu — deer; genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of the deer' (noun + case) [鹿 的]
glossary.horimlažu: horim — path; -la- makes a verb, converb -žu, 'following the path' (noun-derived verb, converb) [徑依着]
glossary.burγasun: burγasun — elm switches, withes (Ming 楡條) (noun) [楡條]
glossary.gerlen: ger — tent, hut; -le- makes a verb, converb -n, 'making a hut' (noun-derived verb, converb) [做着]
glossary.γarulaγ̇a: γar- — to go out, to go up; linking vowel + -laγ̇a, 'went up' (verb, past narrative; ending uncertain) [上去來]
glossary.burqan-qaldun-a: Burqan-Qaldun — the holy mountain of the Mongols; dative-locative -a, 'at, to', here marking the one who acts in a passive sentence (name + case; the Ming 納 is the case mark) [山名 納]
glossary.böġesün-ü: böġesün — louse (Ming 虱子); genitive -ü, 'of a louse' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [虱子 的]
glossary.bolžiγ̇uldaba: bolžiγ- — to dodge, to slip away (stem uncertain); causative -γ̇ul-, passive -da-, past -ba, 'was made to slip away, was spared' (verb, causative passive past) [被躱閃過了]
glossary.γaγčaqan: γaγča — single, only, alone; ending -qan (Ming 自 'by oneself'; uncertain), 'alone' (adjective + ending) [獨自]
glossary.qairalan: qaira- — to cherish, to spare (stem uncertain; Ming 愛惜); -la- verb-maker, converb -n, 'sparing' (verb, converb) [愛惜]
glossary.qadaγai-jin: qadaγai — an animal's name (Ming 獸名; not identified); genitive -jin after a vowel (noun + case) [獸名 的]
glossary.qalγasun: qalγasun — split-open willow twigs (Ming 破開柳條的) (noun; analysis uncertain) [破開柳條的]
glossary.qaldun: Qaldun — Qaldun, the holy mountain (short name for Burqan-Qaldun) [山名]
glossary.qaldun-burqan-a: Qaldun-Burqan — the same holy mountain with the two names in the other order; dative-locative -a, 'at, to' (name + case) [山名 行]
glossary.qarča-jin: qarča — an ant? (the Ming has only (蟻的) in brackets, 'of an ant'; uncertain); genitive -jin after a vowel (noun + case) [(蟻的)]
glossary.qalqalaγdaba: qalqala- — to shield, to protect (Ming 遮護); passive -γda-, past -ba, 'was shielded' (verb, passive past) [被遮護 了]
glossary.ajuγ̇uldaba: aju- — to fear, to be afraid; causative -γ̇ul-, passive -da-, past -ba, 'was frightened' (verb, causative passive past) [被驚怕了]
glossary.burqan-qaldun-i: Burqan-Qaldun — the holy mountain of the Mongols; accusative -i, 'the mountain (object)' (name + case) [山名 行]
glossary.manaγar-büri: manaγar — morning; distributive -büri, 'every morning' (noun + distributive) [每早]
glossary.malijasuγai: maliya- — to sacrifice, to make an offering (stem inferred from the Ming 祭祀); optative -suγai, 'let me sacrifice, I will' (verb, optative, first person, back-vowel form) [祭祀]
glossary.öčisügei: öči- — to pray (stem inferred from the Ming 禱告); optative -sügei, 'let me pray, I will' (verb, optative, first person, front-vowel form) [禱吿]
glossary.uruγ-un: uruγ — offspring, descendants, lineage; genitive -un, 'of the lineage' (noun + case; Ming 子子) [子子]
glossary.uqatuγai: uqa- — to know, to understand; optative -tuγai, 'let it be known, let him know' (verb, optative, third person) [省着]
glossary.büse-ben: büse — belt, girdle; reflexive-possessive -ben, 'one's own belt' (noun + reflexive-possessive) [帶 自的行]
glossary.güžüġün-düri: güžüġün — neck; dative-locative -dür, 'at the neck'; the (i) is Shiratori's, the token before the reflexive -(i)jen (noun + case) [項 自的行]
glossary.erigeležü: erigele- — to hang (stem inferred from the Ming 掛着); converb -žü, 'hanging' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [掛着]
glossary.maqalai-ban: maqalai — cap, hat (Ming 帽子); reflexive-possessive -ban, 'one's own hat' (noun + reflexive-possessive, back-vowel form) [帽子 自的行]
glossary.seġežigeležü: seġežigele- — to hang (stem inferred from the Ming 掛着); converb -žü, 'hanging' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [掛着]
glossary.γari: γar — hand; the (i) is Shiratori's, the token left before the reflexive -(i)jan, 'one's own hand' (noun) [手 自的行] · also before the instrumental -jar: γar(i)-jar, 'with the hand' (Ming 手用; the (i) is Shiratori's)
glossary.ebčeġün-düri: ebčeġün — chest, breast; dative-locative -dür, 'at the chest'; the (i) is Shiratori's, the token before the reflexive -(i)jen (noun + case) [胸 自的行]
glossary.jesünte: jesün — nine; dative-locative -te, 'nine times' (numeral + case, front-vowel form; Ming 遍 'times') [九遍]
glossary.sögödčü: sögö- — to kneel (stem inferred from the Ming 跪); converb -dčü, 'kneeling' (verb, converb; the d is unexplained) [跪着]
glossary.sačuli: sačuli — libation, a sprinkled offering (Ming 灑奠; form uncertain) (noun) [灑奠]
glossary.öčiġüli: öčiġüli — prayer, invocation (Ming 禱祝; form uncertain) (noun) [禱祝︀]
glossary.keleležü: kele- — to speak, to say; -le- verb-maker, converb -žü, 'speaking' (verb, converb) [說着]
glossary.kereid-ün: Kereid — the Kereid, a people (the -d is probably a plural); genitive -ün, 'of the Kereid' (people name + case) [種名 的]
glossary.toγ̇oril: Toγ̇oril — To'oril, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.waṅ-qan-dur: Waṅ-Qan — Wang Qan, ruler of the Kereid (Chinese wang 'prince' + qan); dative-locative -dur, 'to, at' (title + case, back-vowel form) [皇帝 行]
glossary.tuγ̇ula: Tuγ̇ula — the Tuγ̇ula river (river name) [河名]
glossary.merkid-te: Merkid — the Merkid, a people; dative-locative -te, 'to the Merkid' (people name + case, front-vowel form) [種名 行] · also (uncertain) marking the agent, 'by the Merkid'
glossary.genen: genen — unexpectedly, without thinking (Ming 不想; form uncertain) (adverb) [不想]
glossary.büküi-dur: bü- — to be; participle -küi + dative-locative -dur, 'at the being, while being' (verb, participle + case, back-vowel form; Ming 有的 時分) [有的 時分]
glossary.aburažu: abura- — to rescue, to save (Ming 救; elsewhere 'repay'); converb -žu, 'saving' (verb, converb) [救着]
glossary.ögtügei: ög- — to give; optative -tügei, 'let him give, let it be given' (verb, optative, third person, front-vowel form) [與者︀]
glossary.üge-jin: üge — word, speech; genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of the word' (noun + case) [言語的]
glossary.nidoni: nidoni — last year (Ming 去年) (adverb) [去年]
glossary.ügüleleġe: ügüle- — to speak, to say; past -leġe, 'had said' (verb, past; Ming 來 + 麽 'did he say?' in a question) [說來麽] · also with the Ming 說來 and no 麽, 'had said' (not a question)
glossary.abčirarun: abčira- — to bring; converb of time -run, 'when bringing' (verb, converb) [將來時]
glossary.čaγ-un: čaγ — time; genitive -un, 'of the time, in the time' (noun + case) [時裏]
glossary.emüšgegdeġesü: emüs- — to wear, to put on (stem inferred from the Ming 穿); passive -gde-, conditional -ġesü, 'if it is worn' (Ming 呵) (verb, passive conditional) [被穿了呵]
glossary.bügüdgeldüžü: bügüd- — to gather (stem uncertain; Ming 收集); reciprocal -ldü- (the g between stem and ending is unexplained), converb -žü, 'gathering together' (verb, converb; the middle ending is uncertain) [相收集着]
glossary.qamtudγaldužu: qamtu- — together (stem and endings uncertain; Ming 相收合 'bring together'); extension -dγal-, reciprocal -du-, converb -žu, 'bringing together' (verb, converb) [相收合着]
glossary.čegerei-jin: čegerei — chest cavity (Ming 腔子); genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of the chest' (noun + case) [腔子 的]
glossary.bökörei: bökörei — kidney, loin (Ming 腰子); the token left before the genitive -jin in bököre(i)-jin (noun) [腰子 的]
glossary.jin: -jin — genitive: of (after a vowel; the token left after bököre(i)-, 'of the kidney') [腰子 的]
glossary.bögše-dür: bögše — tip, point, end (Ming 尖兒); dative-locative -dür, 'at the tip' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [尖兒 裏]
glossary.keġeleġe: keġe- — to say; past -leġe, 'had said' (verb, past) [說來]
glossary.üge-düri: üge — word, speech; dative-locative -dür, 'in the word'; the (i) is Shiratori's, the token before the reflexive -(i)jen (noun + case) [言語 自的行]
glossary.kürün: kür- — to reach, to arrive; converb -n, 'arriving' (verb, converb) [到]
glossary.bügüde: bügüde — all, altogether (Ming 都) (adverb, quantifier) [都︀]
glossary.büreltele: bürel- — to be destroyed, to perish (stem inferred from the Ming 毀滅); -tele, 'until' (verb + postposition; 'until destruction') [直至毀滅]
glossary.qaltačižu: qaltači- — to break, to smash (stem inferred from the Ming 破); converb -žu, 'breaking' (verb, converb) [破着]
glossary.börte-ji: Börte — Börte (short for Börte-Üjin), a woman's name; accusative -ji after a vowel, 'Börte (object)' (name + case) [婦人名 行]
glossary.qariγ̇ulžu: qari- — to turn back, to return; causative -γ̇ul-, converb -žu, 'sending back' (verb, causative converb) [囘着]
glossary.abčiraja: abčira- — to bring; hortative -ja, 'let us bring' (verb, first person plural) [將來]
glossary.deġü-de: deġü — younger brother; dative-locative -de, 'to the younger brother' (noun + case) [弟 行]
glossary.kelen: kelen — word, speech, language (noun) [言語] · also 'word, speech' (Ming 話)
glossary.qorqonaγ-žubur-a: Qorqonaγ-Žubur — Qorqonaq-Jubur, a place name; dative-locative -a, 'at, in' (name + case; Ming 地名) [地名(裏)]
glossary.endēče: ene — this; ablative -ēče, 'from here' (pronoun + case, long vowel; endē is the adverb 'here') [這裏(自)]
glossary.tümed: tümen — ten thousand, a tümen; plural -d, 'tümens' (numeral noun + plural) [萬每]
glossary.morilasu: mori — horse (morin); -la- makes a verb, optative -su, 'let me mount, I will mount' (noun-derived verb, optative, first person) [上馬]
glossary.žeġün: žeġün — left (hand or side; Ming 左) (adjective) [左] · also a man's name, Jegün (personal name; Ming 人名)
glossary.morilatuγai: mori — horse (morin); -la- makes a verb, optative -tuγai, 'let him mount' (noun-derived verb, optative, third person) [敎(上)馬]
glossary.bolžaγ̇an: bolža- — to appoint, to agree on a meeting (stem inferred; Ming 約會); ending -γ̇an (uncertain), 'appointment' (verb or noun) [約會]
glossary.žamuqa-dāča: Žamuqa — Jamuqa, a man's name; ablative -dāča, 'from Jamuqa' (name + case; long vowel, uncertain) [人名 處]
glossary.žamuqa-dur: Žamuqa — Jamuqa, a man's name; dative-locative -dur, 'to Jamuqa' (personal name + case, back-vowel form) [人名 行]
glossary.anda-da: anda — sworn brother, pledged friend; dative-locative -da, 'to the sworn brother' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [契合 行]
glossary.oro-ban: oro — place, seat, position (Ming 位; the same spelling as oro 'hollow of the chest'); reflexive-possessive -ban, 'one's own place' (noun + reflexive-possessive, back-vowel form) [位(自的行)]
glossary.bolγaγdaγ̇a: bol- — to become; causative -γa- + passive -γda- + past -γ̇a, 'was made into' (verb, causative passive past; the -γ̇a is uncertain) [被做了]
glossary.onor: onor — nock, the notch of an arrow (so read from onolaba; the Ming 扣子 is 'button, fastening') (noun) [(扣子)]
glossary.nigenten: nigen — one; -ten, a collective plural, 'those of one ...' (numeral + plural ending; compare -tan in Žaqaγambu-tan; uncertain) [一箇的(每)]
glossary.busutu: busutu — 'is it not so?' (rhetorical-question form; analysis uncertain, perhaps busu 'not, other' + -tu 'having') [不是有的麽]
glossary.ösüli: ösül — enmity, grievance to be repaid (noun; Ming 讐 'enmity'); the (i) before the reflexive is Shiratori's [讐 自的(行)]
glossary.ösekün: öse- — to repay (stem as printed in ösekün and ösen, so öse- rather than ösü-; Ming 報); participle -kün, 'how to repay' (verb, participle; uncertain, compare hačilaqun) [報]
glossary.ebüri: ebür — bosom, lap (noun; Ming 懷); the (i) before the reflexive is Shiratori's [懷 自的(行)] · also 'front, the near side' (Ming (前)行 in ebür(i)-jer), the same word
glossary.hemtüldeġe: hemtül- — to be halved (from hemte 'half'; Ming 被去了一半 'half taken away'); passive -de- (the form after l) + past -ġe, the front-vowel partner of -γ̇a in bolγaγdaγ̇a (verb, passive past; both endings uncertain) [被去了一半]
glossary.heligen-ü: helige — liver; stem-final -n- before the case, genitive -ü, 'of the liver' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [肝的]
glossary.hačilaqun: hači-la- — to requite, repay enmity (from hači 'enmity'); participle -qun, 'to repay' (verb, participle; uncertain) [報的]
glossary.ilegsen: ile- — to send; past participle -gsen, 'sent' (verb, participle) [去了的] · also ile- 'to send', past participle -gsen (Ming 敎來的)
glossary.ügülegsen: ügüle- — to speak, to say; past participle -gsen, 'spoken' (verb, participle) [說了的]
glossary.üges-i: üge — word, speech; plural -s + accusative -i, 'the words' as object (noun + plural + case) [言語每(行)]
glossary.žamuqa-da: Žamuqa — Jamuqa, a man's name; dative-locative -da, 'to Jamuqa' (personal name + case, back-vowel form) [人名 行] · also after a passive, naming the agent: 'by Jamuqa'
glossary.ečige-de: ečige — father; dative-locative -de, 'to the father' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [父 行]
glossary.kigdegsen-i: ki- — to do, to make; passive -gde- + past participle -gsen, 'what was done'; accusative -i (verb, passive participle + case; the passive leaves the doer open) [被做了的 行]
glossary.qamtudqu: qamtud- — to be together, to join (from qamtu 'together'; stem inferred; Ming 相合); participle -qu, 'joint' (verb, participle) [相合的]

glossary.daġusugan: daġusu- — to finish, use up (stem inferred; Ming 敎盡 'cause to be finished'); causative -γa- (Ming 敎) + converb -n, 'having made an end' (verb, causative converb) [敎盡]
glossary.anda-ji: anda — sworn brother, pledged friend; accusative -ji after a vowel-final stem, 'the sworn brother' as object (noun + case) [契合 行]

glossary.ebedbe: ebed- — to hurt, to be sick; past -be, 'hurt' (verb, past) [痛了]

glossary.hemterebe: hemtere- — to be halved (from hemte 'half'; stem inferred; Ming 半了); past -be, 'became half' (verb, past) [半了]

glossary.uduid: Uduid — the Uduid, a Merkid clan (Ming 姓氏 'clan name') [姓氏]
glossary.uwas: Uwas — the Uwas, a Merkid clan (Ming 姓氏 'clan name') [姓氏]

glossary.üžin-börte-jen: Üžin-Börte — Üjin-Börte, a woman's name (one two-part name); reflexive-possessive -jen, 'one's own Üjin-Börte' (personal name + reflexive-possessive, front-vowel form) [婦人名]

glossary.gölme: gölme — saddle-cloth (Ming 鞍韂 'saddle and saddle-cloth') (noun) [鞍韂]
glossary.dabšiqui-dur: dabši- — to slap, to beat (stem inferred from the Ming 拍); participle -qui + dative-locative -dur, 'at the slapping, when slapped' (verb, participle + case, back-vowel form) [拍 時]

glossary.nuγ̇ura: Nuγ̇ura — Nu'ura, a place name (Ming 地名) [地名]
glossary.dabčitu: dabči — lid, cover (stem inferred; Ming 葢子 'lid'); possessive -tu, 'having a lid' (noun + possessive) [葢子有的]

glossary.orqon: Orqon — the Orqon, a river (Ming 水名) [水名]

glossary.talγun: Talγun — Talqun, a place name (Ming 地名) [地名]
glossary.aral-a: aral — island, river-islet (Ming (洲) 'islet'); dative-locative -a, 'on the islet' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [(洲)行]

glossary.kilqo: Kilqo — the Kilqo, a river (Ming 河名) [河名]
glossary.kiṅgüs: kiṅgüs — across, crosswise (Ming 橫斷 'cutting across'; analysis uncertain) [橫斷]
glossary.saqal-bajan: Saqal-Bajan — Saqal-Bajan (Ming 猪鬃草 'boar-bristle grass'; saqal 'beard', bajan 'rich'; a place or a plant, uncertain) [猪︀鬃草]
glossary.sal: sal — raft (noun; Ming 筏子) [筏子]
glossary.toγtoγ̇a-jin: Toγtoγ̇a — Toqto'a, a man's name; genitive -jin after a vowel-final stem, 'of Toqto'a' (personal name + case) [人名 的]
glossary.erkin: erkin — essential, vital, principal (Ming 緊要的 'important') (adjective) [緊要的]

glossary.quγ̇uru: quγ̇ur- — to break, snap (stem inferred; Ming 折了); converb -u, 'breaking' (verb, converb; the ending is uncertain) [折了]
glossary.qotola: qotola — all, altogether (Ming 都行) (adverb) [都︀行]
glossary.boltala: bol- — to become; converb -tala, 'until it becomes' (verb, converb) [到了]
glossary.qaraγ̇atu: qaraγ̇a — a far view (stem inferred from qara- 'to look'; Ming 遠看見的 'seen from afar'); possessive -tu, 'having' (noun + possessive; could also be read 'far-seeing') [遠看(見)的]

glossary.sačuba: saču- — to sprinkle a libation, to sacrifice (stem inferred; Ming 祭了也); past -ba, 'sacrificed' (verb, past) [祭了也]
glossary.buγa-jin: buγa — bull (Ming 强牛 'strong ox'); genitive -jin after a vowel-final stem, 'of the bull' (noun + case) [强牛 的]
