glossary.qur: qurdun — fast; a fast horse (Ming 快馬); the first half, the word being cut across two printed tokens, qur- / dun(i)-jan (adjective or noun, split word) [快馬]

glossary.üldü-beġen: üldü — sword, scimitar (Ming 環刀 'ring-sword'); reflexive-possessive -beġen, 'one's own sword' (noun + reflexive-possessive, front-vowel form) [環刀 自的行]

glossary.anda-jin: anda — sworn brother, pledged friend; genitive -jin after a vowel-final stem, 'of the sworn brother' (noun + case) [契合 的]
glossary.ulus-ača: ulus — people, realm; ablative -ača, 'from the people' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [百姓 裏]
glossary.tümen: tümen — ten thousand, a tümen (numeral noun; Ming 萬) [萬]
glossary.bolžal: bolžal — appointment, meeting (noun; Ming 約會) [約會]
glossary.neiledüje: neile- — to join, to come together (Ming 相合); reciprocal -dü- (written without the l of -ldü-; uncertain) + hortative -je, 'let us join one another' (verb, reciprocal hortative, front-vowel form) [相合咱]
glossary.žamuqa-jin: Žamuqa — Jamuqa, a man's name; genitive -jin after a vowel-final stem, 'of Jamuqa' (personal name + case) [人名 的]
glossary.temüžin-e: Temüžin — Temüjin, a man's name; dative-locative -e, 'to Temüjin' (personal name + case) [人名 行] · also with Ming (人)名 行, 'to Temüjin'
glossary.kürgebe: kürge- — to bring to, to deliver (kür- 'reach' made causative; uncertain); past -be, 'delivered' (verb, past) [送到了]
glossary.kelüren-ü: Kelüren — the Kelüren, a river (Ming 河名); genitive -ü, 'of the Kelüren' (river name + case, front-vowel form) [河名 的]

glossary.žailan: žaila- — to turn aside, to avoid (stem inferred; Ming 躱 'hide, dodge'); converb -n, 'turning aside' (verb, converb) [躱]
glossary.tana: Tana — the Tana, a stream (Ming 河名) [河名]
glossary.γorqon-a: γorqon — small stream (Ming (小)河); dative-locative -a, 'at the stream' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [(小)河 行]

glossary.neilen: neile- — to join, to come together (Ming 相合); converb -n, 'joining' (verb, converb) [相合]

glossary.čeriġüd-i: čerig — soldier, army; plural -üd + accusative -i, 'the troops' as object (noun + plural + case) [軍每 行]

glossary.aldažu: aldaž- — to swear, take an oath (stem inferred; Ming 誓); -žu converb: -ing (back-vowel form) [誓着]
glossary.ögölei-čerbi: Ögölei-Čerbi — Ögölei-Cherbi, a man's name (personal name; the meaning of čerbi is not known from these sources) [人名]

glossary.doqolqu-čerbi: Doqolqu-Čerbi — Doqolqu-Cherbi, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.öṅgür: Öṅgür — Önggür, a man's name (personal name) [人名]

glossary.manaγar-un: manaγar — morning, early morning (Ming 淸早 'early'); -un genitive: of (back-vowel form after a consonant) [淸早 的]
glossary.undan: undan — drink, beverage (noun; Ming 飮) [飮]
glossary.meküdeġülsüġei: meküde- — to be lacking, run short (stem inferred; Ming 缺少); -ġül- causative: cause to ...; -süġei optative: 'may ...' (front-vowel form of -suγai) [缺少了]
glossary.üde-jin: üde — evening (noun; Ming 晩夕); -jin genitive: of (after a vowel) [晩夕 的]
glossary.osoldasuγai: osolda- — to be slack, to neglect (stem inferred; Ming 怠慢); -suγai optative: 'may ...' (back-vowel form) [怠慢了]
glossary.baγ̇určin: baγ̇určin — cook (noun; Ming 厨子) [厨子]
glossary.šilegü: šilegü — two-year-old, of two years (adjective; Ming 二歲) [二歲]
glossary.irge: irge — wether, castrated ram (noun; Ming 羯羊) [羯羊] · also 'people' (Ming 百姓), a form of irgen, as in tede irge ičuγaγad 'those people, having turned back'
glossary.sülen: sülen — soup, broth (noun; Ming 湯) [湯]

glossary.qoṅγoγčiγ̇ud: qoṅγoγčiγ̇ud — the yellow ones (plural; Ming 黄色; analysis uncertain) [黄色]

glossary.aduγ̇ulaba: aduγ̇ula- — to herd, to pasture; -ba past (back-vowel form) [牧放了]

glossary.tergeġür: tergeġür — cart-track (terge 'cart' + ġür 'track'; Ming 車路) [車路]

glossary.qarγai-toquraγ̇un: Qarγai-Toquraγ̇un — Qarqai-Toqura'un, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.qasar-luγ̇a: Qasar — Qasar, a man's name (personal name); -luγ̇a comitative: with, together with (back-vowel form; Ming 一同) [人名 一同]
glossary.üldüs: üldü — knife, sword (stem inferred; Ming 刀); -s plural: swords [刀每]
glossary.aγsažu: aγsa- — to wear, carry at the belt (stem inferred; Ming 帶 'wear, carry'); -žu converb: -ing (back-vowel form) [帶着]

glossary.aduγ̇u: aduγ̇u — herd of horses (noun; Ming 馬羣) [馬羣] · also 'herd, livestock' (Ming 頭口 'head of stock, beasts'), with ideġen 'food'
glossary.aduγ̇ulatuγai: aduγ̇ula- — to herd, to pasture; -tuγai optative: 'let them ...' (Ming 者 'let') [牧放者︀]
glossary.argai-qasar: Argai-Qasar — Arqai-Qasar, a man's name (personal name) [人名]

glossary.odora: odora — an arrow name (Ming 箭名) [箭名]

glossary.qurijaldusu: qurija- — to gather up, tidy (stem inferred; Ming 收拾); -ldu- reciprocal: 'together, jointly' (Ming 共); -su optative: 'let me ...' (back-vowel form) [共收拾]

glossary.nemežü: neme- — to add, to increase; converb -žü, 'adding' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [添着]
glossary.igeġegdeġesü: igeġe- — to protect, to help (stem inferred from the Ming 護助); passive -gde-, conditional -ġesü, 'if (one) is helped, protected' (verb, passive conditional, front-vowel form) [被護助呵]
glossary.anda-ača: anda — sworn brother, pledged friend (Ming 契合); ablative -ača, 'from the sworn brother' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [(契合)處]
glossary.nököčešü: nököče- — to be a companion (from nökör; stem inferred); -šü, an ending of exhortation (uncertain; the Ming 做伴我 'be a companion to me'), 'let ... be companions' (verb, ending uncertain) [做伴我]
glossary.ötögüs: ötögü(n) — old man, elder; plural -s, 'elders' (noun + plural) [老的每]
glossary.ölže: ölže — good fortune, blessing (noun; the first part of ölže-ten, split by the line break) [吉慶]

glossary.boluγ̇užai: bol- — to become; ending -uγ̇užai (uncertain; the Ming 做麽 reads it as a question, 'shall (they) become?') (verb, ending uncertain) [做麽]
glossary.tüšibe: tüši- — to entrust, to commit to (Ming 委付); past -be, 'entrusted' (verb, past, front-vowel form) [委付了]
glossary.tan-i: tan- — you (plural polite; stem of ta before a case ending); accusative -i, 'you' as object (pronoun + case) [您行]
glossary.qān-dur: qān — ruler, khan (the short form beside qaγan); dative-locative -dur, 'to the qan' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [皇帝 行]
glossary.daγai: Daγai — Daqai, a man's name (personal name) [人名]

glossary.qā: qā — qaγan, sovereign (a contracted form of qaγan; plural qād) (noun, title) [皇帝]
glossary.eje-ben: eje — counsel, consultation, agreement (Ming 商量); reflexive-possessive -ben, 'one's own counsel' (noun + reflexive-possessive, front-vowel form) [商量自的(行)]

glossary.taludqun: talu- — to untie, to loosen (stem inferred from the Ming 解); -dqun, imperative, second person plural (verb, ending uncertain) [解了您]
glossary.žaqa-ban: žaqa — collar (Ming 衣領); reflexive-possessive -ban, 'one's own collar' (noun + reflexive-possessive, back-vowel form) [衣領 自的行]
glossary.tamtuludqun: tamtulu- — to tear (stem inferred from the Ming 扯); -dqun, imperative, second person plural (verb, ending uncertain) [扯了您]
glossary.iležü: ile- — to send, to go (the Ming glosses 去着 'going'); converb -žü, 'sending, going' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [去着] · also 'causing to go, sending' (Ming 敎去着)
glossary.arγai-qasar: Arγai-Qasar — Arqai-Qasar, a man's name (personal name; Arγai 'Arqai' with Qasar) [人名]

glossary.büteġežü: büteġe- — to complete, bring about (verb; Ming 完備; stem uncertain); converb -žü, 'completing' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [完備着]

glossary.telegetü: Telegetü — a man's name (personal name; Ming gives only 人名; printed 'Telegetü- Bajan-u', joined with the next word) [人名]
glossary.bajan-u: bajan — rich (adjective; Ming 富的, also used as a name element) + genitive -u, 'of the rich one' (adjective + case, back-vowel form) [富的]
glossary.küġün-uγ̇a: Küġün-Uγ̇a — a man's name (personal name; Ming gives only 人名) [人名]
glossary.čilaγ̇un-γaiči: Čilaγ̇un-Γaiči — Chila'un-Gaichi, a man's name (personal name; Γaiči a title, perhaps 'cattle-herd'; uncertain) [人名]
glossary.žebke: Žebke — Jebke, a man's name (personal name; Ming gives only 人名) [人名]
glossary.ažuγ̇ui: a- — to be, to remain (verb); past ending -žuγ̇ui, 'was, remained' (verb, past, back-vowel form; uncertain) [有來]
glossary.muqali: Muqali — a man's name (personal name; Ming gives only 人名) [人名]
glossary.buqa: Buqa — a man's name (personal name; Ming gives only 人名) [人名] · also buqa, 'bull' (Ming 强牛 'strong ox'), a common word and not the name, as in γurban buqa, 'three bulls'

glossary.aγ̇ulžažü: aγ̇ulža- — to have an audience, be received, wait on a lord (verb; Ming 拜見 'pay respects'); converb -žü, 'waiting on' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [拜見着]
glossary.bosoγa-jin: bosoγa — threshold (noun; Ming 門限) + genitive -jin, 'of the threshold' (noun + case, after a vowel) [門限的]
glossary.bosoγa-dāča: bosoγa — threshold (noun; Ming 門限) + ablative -dāča, 'from the threshold' (noun + case, back-vowel form; Shiratori's long ā) [門限 行]
glossary.hoγtol: hoγtol- — to cut (verb; stem inferred from the Ming 割); here a bare stem, perhaps an imperative (verb stem; uncertain) [割]
glossary.emčü: emčü — one's own, private (adjective; Ming 梯已, 'personal'), so 'private slave' [梯已]
glossary.heilüġešü: heilüġe- — to leave, depart (verb; stem inferred from the Ming 離); conditional -šü, 'if one leaves' (verb, conditional; Ming 呵, form uncertain) [離了呵]

glossary.gedkün: gedkü- — to cast aside, abandon (verb; Ming 撇); converb -n, 'casting aside' (verb, converb) [撇] · also ge- 'to cast aside, throw away' (Ming 棄了; reading uncertain) + imperative second person plural -dkün, 'cast (him) aside' (Ming 您)
glossary.tüṅge: Tüṅge — Tüngge, a man's name (personal name; Ming gives only 人名) [人名] · Tüṅge, a stream (river name; Ming (河名)), as in Tüṅge γorqan 'the Tünge little river' [(河名)]
glossary.qaši: Qaši — Qashi, a man's name (personal name; Ming gives only 人名) [人名]
glossary.bosoγa: bosoγa — threshold (noun; Ming 門限) [門限]
glossary.oduγ̇asu: od- — to go (verb; stem inferred from the Ming 去); conditional -uγ̇asu, 'if one goes' (verb, conditional, back-vowel form; Ming 呵) [去呵]
glossary.tasulžu: tasul- — to cut off, sever (verb; stem inferred from the Ming 斷); converb -žu, 'cutting off' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [斷着]
glossary.örgen: örgen — wide, broad (adjective; Ming 寬) [寬]
glossary.öġere: öġere — other, otherwise, different (adjective or adverb; Ming 別) [別] · also 'apart, separately' (Ming 𠮠)
glossary.miderižü: mideri- — to kick (verb; stem inferred from the Ming 踢); converb -žü, 'kicking' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [踢着]
glossary.žebke-ji: Žebke — Jebke, a man's name (personal name) + accusative -ji, 'Jebke' as object (name + case, after a vowel; Shiratori's -ji) [人名]
glossary.boroγ̇ül: Boroγ̇ül — Boroqul, a boy's name (personal name; Ming gives only 人名; a spelling of Boroγ̇ul) [人名]
glossary.aγ̇ulžan: aγ̇ulža- — to have an audience, be received, be presented (verb; Ming 拜見); converb -n, 'being presented' (verb, converb) [拜見]
glossary.oldaγsan: ol- — to find, get (verb; compare olba, 'got') + -da- (verbal suffix, function unclear; compare bol-da-ba; uncertain) + -γsan, past participle 'that has been gotten' (verb, participle; Ming 得了的) [得了的]
glossary.šigigen-qutuqu: Šigigen-Qutuqu — Shigigen-Qutuqu, a boy's name (personal name; Ming gives only 人名) [人名]
glossary.boroγ̇ul: Boroγ̇ul — Boroqul, a boy's name (personal name; Ming gives only 人名) [人名]
glossary.dörben-i: dörben — four (numeral) + accusative -i, 'the four' as object (numeral + case) [四箇 行]
glossary.bolγaquju: bol- — to become (verb); causative -γa-; participle -qu 'that will …'; interrogative particle -ju (Ming 麽; uncertain) (verb, causative participle + question particle; uncertain) [得做麽]
glossary.bolurun: bol- — to become (verb); -urun, converb of time, 'when becoming' (verb, converb; Ming 做的) [做的]
glossary.ökin-balaqaγ: Ökin-Balaqaγ — Ökin-Balaqaq, a man's name (personal name; Ming gives only 人名; earlier parts print Ökin-Barqaγ) [人名]
glossary.sorqatu-žürki: Sorqatu-Žürki — Sorqatu-Jurki, a man's name (personal name; Ming gives only 人名) [人名]
glossary.irgen-ü-ġen: irgen — people, subjects (noun) + linking vowel -ü- + reflexive-possessive -ġen, 'one's own people' (noun + reflexive-possessive; Shiratori's division) [百姓 自的行]

glossary.helige-dür: helige — liver (noun; Ming 肝; elsewhere eligen) + dative-locative -dür, 'in the liver' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [肝行]
glossary.šülšütü: šülšü — gallbladder, courage (noun; Ming 膽; stem uncertain) + possessive -tü, 'courage-having' (noun + possessive, front-vowel form) [膽 有的]
glossary.heregei-dür: heregei — thumb (noun; Ming 大拇指; stem uncertain) + dative-locative -dür, 'on the thumb' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [大拇指 行]
glossary.hončitan: hončitan — able to shoot arrows (adjective; Ming 能發箭的; analysis uncertain) [能發箭的]
glossary.duγ̇uraṅ: duγ̇uraṅ — full (adjective; Ming 滿; compare düġüreṅ) [滿]
glossary.žirügetü: žirüge — heart (noun) + possessive -tü, 'heart-having' (noun + possessive, front-vowel form) [心有的]
glossary.düġüreṅ: düġüreṅ — full (adjective; Ming 滿; compare duγ̇uraṅ) [滿]
glossary.aγ̇urtan: aγ̇ur — spirit, fierce energy (noun; Ming 剛氣; stem uncertain) + possessive plural -tan, 'those having spirit' (noun + possessive, plural, back-vowel form) [剛氣]
glossary.tutum: tutum — each, every one (pronoun or adjective; Ming 各各) [各各] · also 'each time, every turn' (Ming 每遍), as in toγ̇oriqui tutum 'each time they wheel'

glossary.bökös: bökö — strong, sturdy (adjective; Ming 壯) + plural -s, 'the strong' (adjective + plural) [壯]
glossary.küčüten-i: küčü — strength (noun) + possessive plural -ten + accusative -i, 'those having strength' as object (noun + possessive + case, front-vowel form) [氣力有的(每) 行]
glossary.šülšüten: šülšü — gallbladder, courage (noun; Ming 膽; stem uncertain) + possessive plural -ten, 'those having courage' (noun + possessive, plural, front-vowel form) [膽 有的(每)]
glossary.omoγtan: omoγ — pride, daring (noun; Ming 勇; stem uncertain) + possessive plural -tan, 'those having daring' (noun + possessive, plural, back-vowel form) [勇 有的(每)]

glossary.ülidkebe: ülidke- — to destroy, wipe out (verb; Ming 敎毀滅了; stem uncertain); past -be, 'destroyed' (verb, past, front-vowel form) [敎毀滅了]

glossary.ködölgen: ködöl- — to move, stir (stem inferred); causative -ge-, 'make …' (the Ming 敎; form uncertain); converb -n, '-ing' (verb, causative converb) [敎動]
glossary.daruqu: dara- — to press down, crush; participle -qu, 'one who …s' (verb, participle) [壓住]
glossary.bökö: bökö — wrestler, strongman (noun; the Ming gives 勇士 'brave man' for it at the end of §140) [力士]
glossary.abalduγ̇ulba: abal- — to wrestle, grapple (stem as in abaldurun, inferred from the Ming 搏; uncertain); reciprocal -ldu-, 'with one another'; causative -γ̇ul-, 'make …'; past -ba, '-ed' (back-vowel form) (verb, reciprocal causative past tense) [敎厮搏了]
glossary.ilaγdaqu: ilaγ- — to overcome, defeat (stem inferred from the Ming; compare ilaγ̇a- in ilaγču); passive -da-, 'be …ed'; participle -qu, 'that is to be …ed' (verb, passive participle) [可勝的]

glossary.irügei-jen: irügei — lower lip; reflexive-possessive -jen, 'one's own' (front-vowel form) (noun + reflexive-possessive) [下唇 自的行]

glossary.žaqas: žaqas — collar, lapel (the -s may be a plural; read from the Ming 領) (noun) [領]
glossary.sobin: sobi- — to cross, join (stem inferred from the Ming; uncertain); converb -n, '-ing' (verb, converb; stem uncertain) [交]

glossary.niruγ̇u-ban: niruγ̇u — spine, backbone; reflexive-possessive -ban, 'one's own' (back-vowel form) (noun + reflexive-possessive) [脊梁 自的(行)]

glossary.udaγ̇adu: udaγ̇adu — next, second in order (ordinal adjective) [次]
glossary.qutuγtu-müṅler: Qutuγtu-Müṅler — Qutuqtu-Müngler, a man's name (personal name) [人名]

glossary.barqaγ-un: Barqaγ — Barqaq, a man's name (personal name); genitive -un, 'of' (back-vowel form) (name + genitive) [人名的]
glossary.köġüd-tür: köġün — son; -d: plural; dative-locative -tür, 'to, among' (front-vowel form) (noun + dative-locative) [兒子每 行]

glossary.eburidčü: ebürid- — to hold in the bosom, harbour (stem uncertain; from ebür 'bosom'? Ming 懷着 'cherishing'); converb -čü (verb, converb after a consonant, front-vowel form; a spelling of ebüridčü) [懷着]

glossary.žobaγ̇amu: žobaγ̇a- — to afflict, cause hardship (Ming 敎辛苦 'make toil'; stem uncertain); present -mu, 'afflicts' (verb, present tense) [敎辛苦有]
glossary.eġün-i: eġün — this one (the oblique stem of ene before case endings); accusative -i, 'this one' as object (pronoun + case) [這箇 行]

glossary.qoniči: qoniči — shepherd, sheep-herder (perhaps qonin 'sheep' + agent -či; Ming 牧羊的) (noun) [牧羊(的)]
glossary.horγužu: horγu- — to flee (stem uncertain; Ming 逃着); converb -žu, 'fleeing' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [逃着]
glossary.sartaγ̇ul-un: Sartaγ̇ul — the Muslims of Central Asia, Sarta'ul (Ming 囘囘 'Muslims'); genitive -un after a consonant (people name + case) [囘囘的]
glossary.čui: Čui — the Chu, a river (Ming 河名 'river name') (river name) [河名]
glossary.daičin: daičin — war, hostility (noun; sense from the Ming 反 'revolt', uncertain) [反]
glossary.uiγ̇ud-un: Uiγud — the Uighurs, a people; genitive -un after a consonant (name + case; a spelling with γ̇ of uiγud-un) [種(名)的]
glossary.taṅγ̇ud-un: Taṅγud — the Tangut, a people; genitive -un after a consonant (name + case; a spelling with γ̇ of taṅγud-un) [種(名)的]
glossary.bitužu: bitu- — to go along, skirt (stem uncertain; Ming 沿着 'going along'); converb -žu (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [沿着]
glossary.jaburun: jabu- — to walk, go about; converb of time -run, 'while going about' (verb, converb; Ming 行時) [行時]
glossary.saγ̇ažu: saγa- — to milk (Ming 擠 'press, milk'); converb -žu, 'milking' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [擠着]

glossary.qaliγ̇un: qaliγ̇un — a horse colour (adjective; Ming 黑髮尾黃 'black mane, yellow tail'; exact sense uncertain) [黑髮尾黃]
glossary.köġün-dür: köġün — son (not küġün 'person'); dative-locative -dür, 'to the son' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [兒行]
glossary.jabuγsani: jabu- — to walk, go about; past participle -γsan, accusative (i), 'what (he) had done on his travels (object)', before the reflexive jan that follows as the token jan (verb, participle + case; the (i) is Shiratori's; Ming 行了的 自的行) [行了的 自的行]

glossary.el-qutur: El-Qutur — El-Qutur, a man's name (one two-part name) (personal name) [人名]
glossary.qulbari: Qulbari — Qulbari, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.arin-taiži-tan: Arin-Taiži — Arin-Taiji, a man's name (taiži a title); -tan, 'and the like, etc.' (Ming 等) (personal name + ending -tan) [人名等]

glossary.čaγ̇aγ̇an-tatar: Čaγ̇aγ̇an-Tatar — the White Tatars (čaγan 'white' + Tatar), a Tatar group (people name) [種(名)]

glossary.dalan-nemürges: Dalan-Nemürges — Dalan-Nemürges, a place (Ming 地名) (place name) [地名]

glossary.olža-dur: olža — booty, spoil, plunder; dative-locative -dur, 'at the spoil' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [財 行]

glossary.olža: olža — booty, spoil, plunder (noun; Ming 財 'wealth') [財]

glossary.egeġerügsen: egeġerü- — to turn back; past participle -gsen, 'who had turned back' (verb, participle, front-vowel form) [翻身的]
glossary.mököriġülüje: mököri- — to cut down, behead (stem uncertain; Ming 斬了); causative -ġül-, hortative -je, 'let us have (them) cut down' (verb, causative hortative, front-vowel form) [斬了者︀咱]
glossary.žasaγlalduba: žasaγ — law; verb-maker -la- 'to regulate', reciprocal -ldu- 'together', past -ba, 'ordered together' (verb derived from a noun, reciprocal past) [共整治了]

glossary.daružu: daru- — to press down, overcome (also written dara-) (Ming 勝着); converb -žu, 'overcoming' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [勝着]
glossary.ulqui: Ulqui — the Ulqui, a river (Ming 河名) (river name) [河(名)]
glossary.šilügelžid: Šilügelžid — Shilügeljid, a place name; the token is the first half of a word split at the line end (place name, split word; Ming 地名) [(地)名]

glossary.neileġülüž: neile- — to unite, join together (Ming 相合); causative -ġül-, converb -ž (written for -žü), 'bringing together' (verb, causative converb; the form is not secure) [相合着]
glossary.čaγan-tatar: Čaγan-Tatar — the White Tatars (čaγan 'white' + Tatar), a Tatar group (people name) [種(名)]
glossary.dutaγ̇ud-tatar: Dutaγ̇ud-Tatar — the Duta'ud Tatars, a Tatar group (people name) [種(名)]

glossary.olžalaγsad: olža — booty; verb-maker -la- 'to take spoil' + past participle plural -γsad, 'those who had taken spoil' (verb derived from a noun, participle plural) [財得的(每)]
glossary.jaγ̇u-ge: jaγ̇u — what; -ge, 'whatever' (indefinite ending; uncertain; Ming 甚麽) (pronoun + particle) [甚麽]

glossary.baraγsan: bara- — to be finished, ruined (here transitive, 'to ruin'); past participle -γsan, 'one who has ruined' (verb, participle) [廢盡的] · also intransitive, 'one that has been ruined, gone to ruin' (Ming 了的, 了了的), of a people
glossary.ečiges-ün: ečige — father; plural -s + genitive -ün (front-vowel form), 'of the fathers' (noun + plural + case) [父親(每)的]
glossary.öšül: öšül — revenge, vengeance, enmity (noun; Ming 讐 'enmity') [讐]

glossary.kisažu: kisa- — to requite, to settle a score; converb -žu, 'requiting' (verb, converb) [報着]

glossary.daγ̇aritai: Daγ̇aritai — Da'aritai, a man's name (personal name; Ming 人名) [人名]

glossary.jesügen: Jesügen — Yesügen, a woman's name (personal name; Ming 女名) [女名] · also glossed (婦人)名 (Ming, 'a woman's name')
glossary.qatun-i: qatun — lady, queen, wife of a qan; accusative -i, 'the lady' as object (Ming 行) (noun + case) [娘子行]
glossary.abba: ab- — to take; past -ba, 'took' (Ming 要了) (verb, past tense) [要了]

glossary.büligi: bü- — to be; past -ligi, 'was' (Ming 有來) (verb, past tense) [有來]

glossary.bögsen: bü- — to be; past participle -gsen, 'having been' (Ming 有來) (verb, participle) [有來]

glossary.qatun-u: qatun — lady, queen, wife of a qan; genitive -u, 'of the lady' (noun + case) [娘子的]

glossary.γada: γada — outside (Ming 外面) (adverb) [外面] · also with Ming 外前 ('outside, in front')

glossary.muqali-tan: Muqali — Muqali, a man's name (Ming 人名); -tan, 'and the like, and others' (Ming 等) (name + collective suffix) [人名 等]

glossary.aimaγ: aimaγ — tribe, clan-group (Ming 部落) (noun) [部落]

glossary.altai: Altai — the Altai, a mountain range (place name) [山名]
glossary.amaγ̇aralin: amaγ̇aralin — closely, cordially (Ming 親厚着; stem and ending unclear) (adverb) [親厚着]
glossary.araγ̇atu: araγ̇a — great tooth, fang (stem inferred from Ming 大牙); possessive -tu, 'big-toothed' (noun + possessive) [大牙有的]

glossary.boroγul: Boroγul — Boroqul, a man's name (personal name) [人名]

glossary.eder-altai-jin: Eder-Altai — the Eder Altai, a place; genitive -jin, 'of' (place name + case) [地名 的]

glossary.qabčal-ača: qabčal — narrow place, defile; ablative -ača, 'from' (noun + case) [狹處]
glossary.ečige-dür: ečige — father; dative-locative -dür, 'at, in, to' (noun + case) [父 行]
glossary.qbaγa-dāča: abaγa — paternal uncle (printed qbaγa); ablative -dāča, 'from' (Shiratori's long ā) (noun + case) [叔叔 行]
glossary.qunan: Qunan — a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.baqaži: Baqaži — Baqaji, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.γurban-telesüd-te: Γurban-Telesüd — Gurban-Telesüd, a place name; locative -te, 'at' (place name + case) [地名處]
glossary.gür-qān-i: Gür-Qān — a title of rulers, here a name; accusative -i, marks the object (title + case) [人名行]
glossary.ögbe-že: ög- — to give; past -be, '-ed'; -že, assertion particle 'indeed' (verb, past + particle) [與了 也者︀]
glossary.tusa-jin: tusa — benefit, favour; genitive -jin, 'of' (after a vowel) (noun + case) [恩的]
glossary.büširegsen: büšire- — to trust; to be grateful (Ming 知感); past participle -gsen, 'that has been …-ed' (verb, participle) [知感了]
glossary.ami-γ̇an: ami — life, breath; reflexive-possessive -γ̇an, 'one's own' (noun + reflexive) [性命自的行]
glossary.gür-qān-dur: Gür-Qān — a title of rulers, here a name; dative-locative -dur, 'at, to' (title + case) [人名]
glossary.müren-e: müren — river; dative-locative -e, 'to, at' (noun + case) [河行]
glossary.odba-že: od- — to go; past -ba, '-ed'; -že, assertion particle 'indeed' (verb, past + particle) [了 也者︀]
glossary.širgöležu: širgöle- — to hold, keep in (Ming 拘 'detain'); converb -žu, '-ing' (verb, converb) [拘着]
glossary.dügsen-ü: -dü- — the second part of the reciprocal -ldü-, 'together'; past participle -gsen, 'that has been …-ed'; genitive -ü, 'of' (verb ending + participle + case; the stem is split off by hyphen) [了的]
glossary.sügegei: Sügegei — Sükegei, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.burgi-ergi-dēče: Burgi-Ergi — a place name; ablative -dēče, 'from' (front-vowel form with long ē) (place name + case) [地名 處]
glossary.uγdun: uγdun — welcome, meeting (Ming 迎接; the stem is uncertain) (noun) [迎接]
glossary.žoluγalduba-že: žoluγ̇al- — to meet (the stem is uncertain); reciprocal -du-, 'one another' (uncertain); past -ba, '-ed'; -že, assertion particle 'indeed' (verb, reciprocal, past + particle) [共遇着了 也者︀]
glossary.žusažu: žun — summer; verb-maker -sa-, 'spend (the summer)'; converb -žu, '-ing' (noun-verb, converb) [住夏着]
glossary.toγtoγ̇a-beki-dür: Toγtoγ̇a-Beki — Toqto'a-Beki, a man's name; dative-locative -dür, 'at, to' (personal name + case) [人名 行]
glossary.qadiγlγ-niliγ̇un-u: Qadiγlγ-Niliγ̇un — Qadiqliq-Nili'un, a place name (Ming 地名; printed so); genitive -u, 'of' (place name + case) [地名的]
glossary.mürüče-seġül: Mürüče-Seġül — Mürüche-Se'ül, a place name [地名]
glossary.barγužin-toγum: Barγužin-Toγum — Barqujin-Toqum, a place name [地名]
glossary.tarijad: tarija — crop, grain; plural -d (noun + plural) [田禾(每)]
glossary.de: -de — dative-locative, 'to' (front-vowel form; the token left after ečige-, 'to the father') (case) [行]
glossary.ölesügsen-i: ölesü- — to be hungry; past participle -gsen, 'that has been …-ed'; accusative -i, marks the object (verb, participle + case) [飢了的行]
glossary.düli-de: düli — noon, midday (Ming 午; the form is uncertain); dative-locative -de, 'to, at' (noun + case) [午行]
glossary.kürgebe-že: kürge- — to make reach, convey; past -be, '-ed'; -že, assertion particle 'indeed' (verb, past + particle) [敎到也 也者︀]
glossary.turuγsan-i: turu- — to grow thin, waste; past participle -γ̇san, 'who has …-ed'; accusative -i, marks the object (verb, participle + case) [瘦了的行]
glossary.žarim-a: žarim — half, part; dative-locative -a, 'to, at' (noun + case) [半(行)]
glossary.küčügürtei-buiruγ: Küčügürtei-Buiruγ — Küchügürtei-Buiruq, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.soquγ-usun-ača: Soquγ-Usun — Soqoq-Usun, a water name; ablative -ača, 'from' (place name + case) [水名處]
glossary.dabaγ̇ulun: daba- — to cross over a pass; causative -γ̇ul-, 'make cross'; converb -un, '-ing' (with linking vowel) (verb, causative, converb) [越過]
glossary.uriṅγu: Uriṅγu — the Urungu, a river (water name) [水名]
glossary.kičil-baši: Kičil-Baši — Kichil-Bash, a lake name (place name) [海︀子名]
glossary.moqudγažu: moqudγa- — to drive to the end (Ming 窮極着; the stem is uncertain); converb -žu, '-ing' (verb, converb) [窮極着]
glossary.abuγ̇ai-že: ab- — to take; past -uγ̇ai (linking vowel + -γ̇ai; uncertain); -že, assertion particle 'indeed' (verb, past + particle) [要了也者︀]
glossary.baidaraγ-balčir-e: Baidaraγ-Balčir — Baidaraq-Balchir, a place name; dative-locative -e, 'to, at' (place name + case) [地名處]
glossary.baiduqui-dur: bai- — to stand; reciprocal -du- (uncertain); participle -qui, 'the …-ing'; dative-locative -dur, 'at, in' (verb, participle + case; Ming 對陣時 'at facing in battle') [對陣時]
glossary.bödölbe-že: bödöl- — to move, set off (Ming 動了; printed b-, for ködöl-); past -be, '-ed'; -že, assertion particle 'indeed' (verb, past + particle) [動了 也者︀]
glossary.boldarun: bol- — to become; passive -da-, 'be …-ed'; converb of time -run, 'when …-ing' (verb, passive, converb) [被做時]
glossary.ködöldežü: ködöl- — to move; passive -de-, 'be …-ed'; converb -žü, '-ing' (front-vowel form) (verb, passive, converb) [被動着]
glossary.keġere: Keġere — Ke'ere, the second half of the place name Saγ̇ari-Keġere (place name) [名]
glossary.baγ̇uba-že: baγ̇u- — to descend, dismount, make camp; past -ba, '-ed'; -že, assertion particle 'indeed' (verb, past + particle) [下了 也者︀]
glossary.qudu: Qudu — Qutu (Qudu), a man's name (personal name; Ming (兒)名) [(兒)名]
glossary.orγa-bari: orγ̇a — household (Ming 人煙 'smoke'); instrumental -bar, 'with, by means of', plus Shiratori's bracketed (i) (noun + case) [人烟 自的連]
glossary.ködölžüġüi-že: ködöl- — to move; past -žüġüi (front-vowel form of -žuγ̇ui), '…-ed'; -že, assertion particle 'indeed' (verb, past + particle) [動了 也者︀]
glossary.kögseġü-sebraγ-a: Kögseġü-Sebraγ — Kökse'ü-Sabraq, a man's name (printed Sebraγ); dative-locative -a, 'to, at'; with a passive verb it names the doer, 'by' (personal name + case) [人名(行)]
glossary.orγa-ban: orγ̇a — household (Ming 人煙 'smoke'); reflexive-possessive -ban, 'one's own' (noun + reflexive) [人烟自的(行)]
glossary.külüġü: külüġü — hero, champion; the stem, split from -d by Shiratori's hyphen or brackets (noun) [傑]
glossary.di: -d — plural, with Shiratori's bracketed (i), perhaps the accusative; the token left before -jen, 'one's own' (the Ming 自的行 covers the reflexive) (plural + case) [(每)自的行]
glossary.külüġüd-ün: külüġü — hero, champion; plural -d; genitive -ün, 'of' (front-vowel form, after d) (noun + plural + case) [傑(每)的]
glossary.ögüġesü: ög- — to give; conditional converb -üġesü, 'if, when' (linking vowel ü + -ġesü) (verb, converb) [與呵] · also an auxiliary after a converb of speech, 'telling, having given' (Ming 與呵 'if given'), where the sense of giving is slight (uncertain)
glossary.čimadba: čimad- — to blame, find fault; past -ba, '-ed' (verb, past) [怪責了]
glossary.čimarun: čimar — blame, reproach, displeasure; genitive -un, 'of' (back-vowel form, after r) (noun + case) [怪責]
glossary.josun-dur: josun — rule, principle, ground; dative-locative -dur, 'at, in' (noun + case) [道理行]
glossary.qubari-quri: Qubari-Quri — a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.idürgen: Idürgen — a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.nögöži-ji: nögöži — the second one(s); accusative -ji, marks the object (after a vowel) (numeral + case) [第二 行]
glossary.ai: ai — alas (interjection; the Ming gives only a sign of panting, so the sense is a guess) [(發喘)] · also with Ming (嘆聲), a sigh, 'alas'
glossary.soiluγ: soiluγ — a second cry printed beside ai (interjection; sense uncertain) [(發喘)]
glossary.qaγačaqu-ju: qaγača- — to part, separate; participle -qu + -ju, which after a participle the Ming marks with 麽, 'is (it) parting?' (verb, participle + question particle; as -ju in §§154-157 and §§165-168; uncertain) [分離的 麽]
glossary.töre-dēče: töre — custom, order, what is right (Ming 道理 'principle'); ablative -dēče, 'from' (noun + case, written with Shiratori's long ē) [道理 行]
glossary.hirižekü-jü: hiriče- — to part from, be estranged (written hiriže-); participle -kü + -jü, 'is parting' (verb, participle + particle; the Ming has 有 'is' and no 麽, so it may be a question or a plain statement, uncertain) [分離 有]
glossary.üile-dēče: üile — deed, affair, business; ablative -dēče, 'from' (noun + case, written with long ē) [勾當 行]
glossary.hiričebe: hiriče- — to part from, be estranged; past -be, '-ed' (verb, past) [分離了]
glossary.čisu-ban: čisun — blood (the n lost before the ending); reflexive-possessive -ban, 'one's own blood' (noun + reflexive-possessive, back-vowel form after a vowel) [血自的(行)]
glossary.γarγaγdasu: γar- — to go out; causative -γa- + passive -γda- + optative -su, 'let it be brought out' (verb, causative passive optative; Ming 者我) [被出者︀我]
glossary.andaγažü: andaγa- — to swear (brotherhood), take an oath (from anda 'sworn brother'; the Ming 說誓 'say an oath'; stem uncertain); converb -žü, 'swearing' (verb, converb) [說誓着]
glossary.sigi-quruγ̇un-u-γ̇an: sigi quruγ̇un — small finger, little finger (sigi from the Ming 小 'small', uncertain; quruγ̇un 'finger'); genitive -u + reflexive-possessive -γ̇an, 'of one's own' (noun + case + reflexive-possessive, back-vowel form) [小 指 自的(行)]
glossary.toli: toli — part of the finger, perhaps the tip (the Ming 指彈 'flicking the finger'; sense uncertain) (noun) [指彈]
glossary.onuči: onuči — notch-cutter, perhaps 'one that cuts a notch' (the Ming 剜箭扣 'cutting an arrow-notch'; uncertain) (noun) [剜箭扣]
glossary.kituγai-bar: kituγai — knife; instrumental -bar, 'with a knife' (noun + case, back-vowel form after a vowel) [刀敎]
glossary.daγtai-dur: daγtai — small birch-bark pail (the Ming 樺皮小桶; stem uncertain); dative-locative -dur, 'in' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [樺皮小桶 裏]
glossary.köġün-e: köġün — son; dative-locative -e, 'to (my) son' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [子行]
glossary.ečige-dēče: ečige — father; ablative -dēče, 'from (the) father' (noun + case, written with long ē) [父行]
glossary.bosγsan: bos- — to rise, set out; participle -γsan, 'the one who has risen' (verb, participle) [起身的]
glossary.uγ̇uqu: uγ̇u- — to drink; participle -qu, 'the drinking' (verb, participle) [飮]
glossary.uγdarun: uγ̇u- — to drink (as in uγ̇uqu); passive -γda- (the u of the stem lost, 'be drunk, be served') + converb -run, 'when/while being served' (verb, passive converb; the analysis is from the Ming 被飮 and is uncertain) [被飮的]
glossary.naidaba-že: naida- — to envy, resent (Ming 妒 'be jealous'); past -ba + assertion particle -že, 'indeed' (verb, past + particle) [妒了也者︀]
glossary.baradqun: bara- — to finish, drain (stem inferred from the Ming 飮了 'drunk up'); -dqun, the plural-command ending, which the Ming reads here as a converb 'having ...-ed'; a command ('drain it!') cannot be ruled out (verb; uncertain) [飮了着]
glossary.kedüi-že: kedüi — how much, how many (adverb); assertion particle -že, 'indeed' [幾多(也者︀)]
glossary.ileġü-ü: ileġü — openly, face to face (adverb; the Ming 對面; uncertain); -ü an ending of uncertain force, the Ming glosses none [對面]
glossary.gesü: ge- — to want, mean to (the Ming 要弃 'wish to cast away'; the stem may be a form of keġe- 'say'; uncertain); optative -sü, 'let me, I will' (verb, optative) [要弃]
glossary.keġeleġei: keġe- — to say; -leġei, past ending of a question, 'did (you) say?' (verb, past question; the Ming 說來麽) [說來麽]
glossary.žüqažü-u: žüqa- — to face, deal with, set against (the Ming 對付 'cope with'; stem uncertain); converb -žü + -u, an ending of uncertain force (as -ü in ileġü-ü) (verb, converb) [對付着]
glossary.qučar-i: Qučar — Quchar, a man's name; accusative -i, marks the object (name + case) [人名(行)]
glossary.bol: bol- — to become, be; the bare stem is a command, 'become!' (verb, imperative) [做]
glossary.bolba-že: bol- — to become, be; past -ba + assertion particle -že, 'indeed', 'agreed to be, became' (verb, past + particle; Ming 肻做了 'agreed to be') [肻做了 也者︀]
glossary.altan-i: Altan — Altan, a man's name; accusative -i, marks the object (name + case) [人名行]
glossary.qān-lu: qān — qan, sovereign; -lu, a particle after Qān (the Ming 但 'only, just'; uncertain) (noun + particle) [皇帝 但]
glossary.aγsa: aγsa- — to go about, travel (stem inferred from the Ming 往來 'going and coming'; the first half of aγsa-γ̇ar, split by the printer) (verb) [往來的]
glossary.γ̇ar: -γ̇ar — instrumental: by, along, following (case suffix, back-vowel form; the second half of aγsa-γ̇ar and the ending in boγ̇ol(i)-γ̇ar, 'as a slave'; Ming 依着 'following') [依着]
glossary.deġe: deġe — above, upper (adverb or noun; the first half of deġere-eče, split by the printer) [上]
glossary.re-eče: -re-eče — -re, an ending of position, 'on the ... side' (uncertain) + ablative -eče, 'from' (the second half of deġe-re-eče, 'from above'; case suffix, front-vowel form) [處]
glossary.boludqun: bolu- — to become, be; -dqun, ending of the plural command, 'you (all) become!' (verb, plural command) [做您]
glossary.jadaba-že: jada- — to be unable, fail (here after a converb: 'unable to bring (it) about'; the exact sense is uncertain); past -ba + assertion particle -že, 'indeed' (verb, past + particle) [不能了 也者︀]
glossary.jadažü: jada- — to be unable (Ming 不能着), after a verb or noun 'unable to ...'; converb -žu written -žü here though the stem is back-vowel (verb, converb; uncertain) [不能着]
glossary.jabuba-že: jabu- — to walk, go about; past -ba + assertion particle -že, 'indeed' (verb, past + particle; Ming 行了 也者︀) [行了 也者︀]
glossary.qaγ̇ulγaγdaγ̇asu: qaγ̇ul- — to drive, rush (stem inferred from the Ming 奔 'run'); causative -γa- + passive -γda- + conditional -γ̇asu, 'if (it) is made to rush' (verb, conditional; the stack of endings is a guess from the Ming) [敎奔呵]
glossary.daγ̇uliqui-dur: daγ̇uli- — to seize, plunder (stem inferred from the Ming 據 'seize'); participle -qui + dative-locative -dur, 'at the time of seizing' (verb, participle + case; Ming 時 'time') [據 時]
glossary.ögüġei: ög- — to give; -üġei, ending of the speaker's intention, 'I will give' (verb; uncertain) [與]
glossary.büleġe-že: bü- — to be; past -leġe, 'there was, used to' + assertion particle -že, 'indeed' (verb, past + particle; Ming 有來) [有來 也者︀]
glossary.oraγ̇a: oraγ̇a — wild, open (adjective; the Ming 野; uncertain) [野]
glossary.uturaγ̇uldaγ̇asu: utura- — to go out and ring (a hunt) (stem inferred from the Ming 出圍 'go out to encircle'); causative -γ̇ul-, passive -da- (uncertain), conditional -γ̇asu, 'if (the hunt) is made to go out' (verb, conditional; the stack is a guess) [敎出圍呵]
glossary.qada-jin: qada — cliff, crag; genitive -jin, 'of the cliff' (noun + case, after a vowel) [崖的]
glossary.gun: gun — mountain crag (the Ming 山崖; uncertain) (noun; printed Gun-(n)u, the token left before -(n)u) [山崖的]
glossary.saitur: saitur — well, properly (adverb; from sain 'good') [好生]
glossary.ögüdkün: ög- — to give; -üdkün, ending of the plural command, 'you (all) give!' (verb, plural command; the front-vowel form of -dqun) [與您]
glossary.keġegdeġüžei: keġe- — to say; passive -gde- + -ġüžei, 'lest ...' (verb, passive + lest-ending; Ming 恐 'lest', 'lest it be said') [恐說被]
glossary.čaγ̇ud-quri-jin: Čaγ̇ud-quri — Chaud-quri, an office or title (Ming 官名 'name of an office'); genitive -jin, 'of' (title + case, after a vowel) [官名的]
glossary.keġeġülüdkün: keġe- — to say; causative -ġül- (the Ming 被說 reads it 'be told') + -üdkün, plural command, 'you (all) cause to be said / have it said' (verb, causative plural command) [被說您]
glossary.müred-ün: müren — river; plural -d + genitive -ün, 'of the rivers' (noun + plural + case, front-vowel form) [河(每)的]
glossary.baγ̇uludqun: baγ̇u- — to settle, halt, camp; causative -γ̇ul- (written -ul-) + -dqun, plural command, 'you (all) make camp!' (verb, causative plural command) [敎下營]
glossary.tumbinai: Tumbinai — Tumbinai, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.oγda: Oγda — Oqda, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.boγ̇oli: boγ̇ol — bondman, slave; the (i) is Shiratori's linking vowel before the instrumental -γ̇ar, 'as a slave' (noun; the Ming reads 行, so the case is uncertain) [奴婢 行]
glossary.bilažu: bila- — to seize, carry off as plunder (stem inferred from the Ming 擄); converb -žu, 'seizing' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [擄着]
glossary.irebe-že: ire- — to come; past -be + assertion particle -že, 'indeed' (verb, past + particle; Ming 來了 也者︀) [來了 也者︀]
glossary.boγ̇ol-un: boγ̇ol — bondman, slave; genitive -un, 'of a slave' (noun + case, after a consonant) [奴婢的]
glossary.sübegei: Sübegei — Sübegei, a man's name (a son's name; personal name) [子名]
glossary.kököčü-kirsaγ̇an: Kököčü-Kirsaγ̇an — Kököchü-Kirsa'an, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.kököčü-kirsaγ̇an-u: Kököčü-Kirsaγ̇an — Kököchü-Kirsa'an, a man's name; genitive -u after n, printed without Shiratori's usual (n) (name + case) [人名的]
glossary.jegei-quṅtaγar: Jegei-Quṅtaγar — Jegei-Qungtaqar, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.jegei-quṅtaγar-un: Jegei-Quṅtaγar — Jegei-Qungtaqar, a man's name; genitive -un after a consonant (name + case) [人名的]
glossary.ulus-ud: ulus — people, subjects; plural -ud (noun + plural) [百姓(每)]
glossary.žüšüridün: žüšüri- — to flatter, fawn (stem inferred from the Ming 諂佞); -dün, an ending probably a converb (verb; uncertain) [諂佞]
glossary.medeġülkün: mede- — to manage, rule (Ming 管); causative -ġül- + -kün, ending of a command (uncertain), 'have (it) managed' (verb, causative command) [敎管]
glossary.borγai-jin: borγai — high ancestor, great-great-grandfather (Ming 高祖); genitive -jin, 'of' (noun + case, after a vowel) [高祖︀ 的]
glossary.elinčüġ-ün: elinčüg — great-grandfather (Ming 曾祖); genitive -ün, 'of' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [曾祖︀的]
glossary.eġüden-ü: eġüden — door; genitive -ü, 'of the door' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [門的]
glossary.ilekü-ji: ile- — to send; participle -kü + accusative -ji, 'the sending (of)' (verb, participle + case, after a vowel) [去的 行]
glossary.sačaγ̇u: sačaγ̇u — alike, equally (adverb; the Ming 一般 'the same') [一般]
glossary.oroγdaqui-jača: oro- — to enter; passive -γda- + participle -qui + ablative -jača, 'from the being entered into' (verb, passive participle + case, after a vowel; Ming (被)入) [(被)入 行]

glossary.šiṅγula: šiṅγula — white, grey (uncertain; Ming 白) (adjective) [白]
glossary.maγ̇uqan: maγu — bad, poor; diminutive -qan, 'a poor little one' (adjective + diminutive; Ming 歹) [歹]
glossary.emeġeltü-ji: emeġel — saddle; -tü, 'having', 'saddled'; accusative -ji (noun + possessive + case; Ming 鞍子 有的行) [鞍子 有的行]
glossary.abtažuγ̇ui: ab- — to take; passive -ta-, 'be taken'; -žuγui, past of a reported fact, 'was taken' (verb, passive, past; Ming 被要了有) [被要了有]
glossary.toridčü: torid- — to halt, stay (stem uncertain; Ming 止); converb -čü, 'halting' (verb, converb) [止着]
glossary.duradγarun: duradγa- — to remind, bring up, mention (stem uncertain; Ming 提說); converb -run, 'when/as (he) brought up' (verb, converb) [提說]
glossary.bidan-lu: bida — we (inclusive); the pronoun's linking -n- and -lu, 'only, just' (uncertain) (pronoun + particle; Ming 咱但) [咱但]
glossary.čadtala: čad- — to be full, sated; -tala, 'until', 'until full' (verb, terminal converb) [喫飽]
glossary.delgen: delgen — spread out, wide, broad (adverb; Ming 展開) [展開]
glossary.γali: γal — fire; the (i) before instrumental -jar is Shiratori's linking vowel, 'with fire' (noun; Ming 敎火 'make fire') [敎火]
glossary.oγžadγaja: oγžadγa- — to give a false alarm (stem inferred from the Ming 虛驚); hortative -ja, 'let us give a false alarm' (verb, hortative) [虛驚]
glossary.hülürigeġültele: hülürige- — to be dazed (stem inferred from the Ming 幌惚); causative -ġül-, 'make dazed'; -tele, 'while, until' (verb, causative, terminal converb) [幌惚間]
glossary.čadumu-že: čad- — to be full, sated; -umu, present, 'is' (uncertain); the particle že, emphatic (uncertain) (verb + particle; Ming 飽有 也者︀) [飽有 也者︀]
glossary.čadγan: čad- — to be full; causative -γa- (inferred from the Ming 敎 'cause'), 'make full'; converb -n, 'having filled' (verb, causative, converb) [敎飽了]
glossary.qaraγ̇ul-i: qaraγul — scout, sentry, lookout; accusative -i, 'the scouts (object)' (noun + case; Ming 哨望的 行) [哨望的 行]
glossary.daručažu: daruča- — to press hard, pursue closely (stem inferred from the Ming 緊逐); converb -žu, 'pressing hard' (verb, converb) [緊逐着]
glossary.neileġülün: neile- — to join, meet; causative -ġül-, 'make join'; converb -n, 'bringing together' (verb, causative, converb) [敎相合]
glossary.samaγ̇ui-dur: samaγui — confusion, disorder; dative-locative -dur, 'in confusion' (noun + case; Ming 亂 裏) [亂 裏]
glossary.qadqulduγ̇asu: qadqul- — to fight; -ldu-, 'each other'; conditional -γasu, 'if/when (they) fight one another' (verb, reciprocal, conditional) [厮殺︀呵]
glossary.bolqu-ju: bol- — to be, become, do; participle -qu; -ju, a question particle (uncertain), 'will it be?' (verb + participle + particle; Ming 中 麽有) [中 麽有]
glossary.duradγaγ̇asu: duradγa- — to remind, bring up, mention (stem uncertain; Ming 提說); conditional -γasu, 'if/when (he) brought it up' (verb, conditional) [提說呵]
glossary.tüleġülüdkün: tüle- — to burn; causative -ġül-, 'make burn'; -d-, plural-subject mark (uncertain); imperative -kün, second person plural (front-vowel form of -qun), 'you all make burn' (verb, causative, imperative) [敎燒您]
glossary.čeriġüd-te: čeri — army, soldiers (compare čerig); plural -ġüd; dative-locative -te, 'to the soldiers' (noun + plural + case, front-vowel form; Ming 軍每行) [軍每行] · also dative-locative -te marking the agent of a passive, 'by the soldiers' (Ming 被軍每)
glossary.tuṅγaba: tuṅγa- — to hand on, proclaim, pass the word (stem uncertain; Ming 傳); past -ba, 'passed on' (verb, past) [傳了]
glossary.tüleġülbe: tüle- — to burn; causative -ġül-, 'make burn'; past -be, 'had burned' (verb, causative, past) [敎燒了]
glossary.hodun: hodun — star; here written with a case ending apart (hodun-(n)ača, ablative 'than the stars') (noun; Ming 星 行) [星 行]
glossary.γaltan: γal — fire; -tan, plural of -tu, 'those having fire' (noun + possessive plural; Ming 火(有的)每) [火(有的)每]
glossary.maγ̇utu: maγu — bad, poor; -tu, 'having', 'poor ones' (adjective + possessive; Ming 歹(有的)) [歹(有的)]
glossary.šiṅγulaqan: šiṅγula — white, grey (uncertain); diminutive -qan, 'whitish, little white' (adjective + diminutive; Ming 白小) [白小]
glossary.bütetele: büte- — to be complete, fill up (Ming 塞滿); -tele, 'until, so that', 'until full' (verb, terminal converb) [塞滿]
glossary.baγ̇uluγ̇a: baγu- — to go down, alight, camp; past -luγa, a reported fact, 'came down, camped' (verb, past; Ming 下了來) [下了來]
glossary.üdür-tür: üdür — day; dative-locative -tür, 'by day, in the daytime' (noun + case, front-vowel form; Ming 日裏) [日裏]
glossary.ündürün: ündür- — to increase, add (stem uncertain; Ming 增添); converb -ün, 'increasing' (verb, converb) [增添]
glossary.qaraγ̇ul-un: qaraγul — scout, lookout, guard; genitive -un, 'of the scouts' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [哨望的]
glossary.qaṅγai-jin: Qaṅγai — the Qanghai, a place; genitive -jin, 'of' (after a vowel) (place name + case; written with a dotted ṅ; the Ming gives only 地名 'place name') [地名 的]
glossary.qačir: Qačir — Qachir, a river (river name; the printed hyphen after it joins it to usun) [水名]
glossary.usun-a: usun — water, river; dative-locative -a, 'at, in' (noun + case) [水行]
glossary.küčülüg: Küčülüg — Küchülüg, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.köġün-düri: köġün — son; dative-locative -dür, 'to'; the (i) is Shiratori's linking vowel before the reflexive jen, 'to one's own son' (noun + case + linking vowel) [子 自的行]
glossary.qamtudun: qamtud- — to join together, be joined (from qamtu 'together'; stem inferred from the Ming 相合, as in qamtudqu and qamtudču); converb -un, 'joining' (verb, converb; uncertain) [相合]
glossary.qaγačaqui: qaγača- — to part, separate; participle -qui, 'the parting' (verb, participle) [離的]
glossary.bolqun-u: bol- — to become, be; participle -qun (analysis uncertain), -u question particle, 'will it be?' (verb + participle + particle; uncertain) [做的 麽]
glossary.nidun: nidün — eye (noun; the Ming writes 眼 with the reflexive 自的行; here nidun-(n)i-jen, 'one's own eye', with accusative -(n)i) [眼 自的行]
glossary.hirmes: hirmes — turning, a turn (the word as printed; stem unknown, the Ming 轉 'turn, revolve') (verb form or noun, uncertain) [轉]
glossary.qadquγdaγ̇asu: qadqu- — to pierce, stab; passive -γda-, conditional -γasu, 'if (it is) pierced' (verb, passive conditional) [被刺呵]
glossary.qaltaril: qaltaril — avoidance, evasion, dodging (noun, perhaps from qaltari- 'to slip, slide', as in qaltariγ̇uluγ̇ad; uncertain) [避]
glossary.qataṅgin: qataṅgin — hard, stubborn, firm (adjective, from qata- 'hard'; compare qataṅγu 'steel-hard'; written with a dotted ṅ) [剛硬]
glossary.qamtudγ̇asu: qamtud- — to join together, be joined (from qamtu 'together'); conditional -γasu, 'if joined' (verb, conditional; uncertain) [相合呵]
glossary.seküġülün: sekü- — to draw back, roll back (stem inferred from the Ming 卷退; uncertain); causative -ġül-, converb -ün, 'making draw back' (verb, causative converb; uncertain) [卷退]
glossary.žibšiġerčü: žibšiġe- — to put in order, array, make ready (stem inferred from the Ming 整搠 and the printed žibšiġer-; compare žibšije-); converb -rčü, 'arranging' (verb, converb; uncertain) [整搠着]
glossary.üdüžü: üdü- — to lure, entice, draw on; converb -žü, 'luring' (verb, converb; stem uncertain) [引誘着]
glossary.ölkes: ölkes — foot of a mountain, the lower slopes (noun; uncertain) [山下]
glossary.kerel: kerel — quarrel, fight, strife (noun, from kere- 'to quarrel') [鬪]
glossary.kerežü: kere- — to quarrel, fight; converb -žü, 'fighting' (verb, converb) [鬪着]
glossary.biqardaγ̇ulun: biqarda- — to be weary, worn out (stem uncertain); causative -γul-, converb -un, 'making weary' (verb, causative converb) [敎疲乏]
glossary.asγaja: asγa- — to pour, pour out; hortative first person -ja, 'let us pour' (verb, hortative; stem uncertain) [注咱]
glossary.an-a: an-a — again, moreover (analysis uncertain; perhaps the oblique stem an- with -a) (adverb or particle, uncertain) [又]
glossary.jadarun: jada- — to be unable, fail, be weak; converb of time -run, 'when unable, being unable' (verb, converb) [不能時]
glossary.qaγ̇āča: qaγa — where; ablative -ača, 'from where' (interrogative + case; analysis uncertain, long ā written for the contraction; Ming 那裏行) [那裏行]
glossary.oluṅkin: oluṅkin — the greater part, most, the many (from olon 'many'; written with a dotted ṅ; uncertain) [多半]
glossary.eme-jin: eme — woman, wife; genitive -jin, 'of the woman' (noun + case, after a vowel) [婦人的]
glossary.čiġeküi: čiġe- — to pass water, make water (stem inferred from the Ming 尿處); participle -küi, 'the place of passing water' (verb, participle; uncertain) [尿處]
glossary.kürdün-ü: kürdün — cart-wheel (the Ming 車腳 'cart foot' suggests the wheel or its rim; uncertain); genitive -ü, 'of the cart-wheel' (noun + case) [車腳的]
glossary.tuγul-un: tuγul — calf (noun); genitive -un, 'of the calf' (noun + case) [犢的]
glossary.belžiġel-dür: belžiġel — grazing, pasture, eating of grass (Ming 喫草; noun, uncertain); dative-locative -dür, 'at, to' (noun + case) [喫草行]
glossary.kürügsen: kür- — to reach, arrive; past participle -ügsen, 'the one who has reached' (verb, participle) [到了的]
glossary.elčin-eče: elčin — envoy, messenger (noun); ablative -eče, 'from, by' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [使臣行]
glossary.eberetele: ebere- — to be in pain, ache (Ming 痛; stem uncertain); terminal -tele, 'until aching' (verb, terminal converb; uncertain) [痛]
glossary.bertetele: berte- — to be hurt, wounded (Ming 傷; stem uncertain); terminal -tele, 'until hurt' (verb, terminal converb; uncertain) [傷]
glossary.iležüküi: ile- — to send (as in ilebe, Ming 敎去了), or 'go' (uncertain which); past -žüküi (cf. -žüġüi), 'sent' (verb, past; ending uncertain) [去了有]
glossary.emečilegden: emečile- — to treat as a woman, make a woman of (from eme 'woman'); passive -gde-, converb -n, 'being made a woman' (verb, passive converb; uncertain) [被做婦人]
glossary.küčütü: küčü — strength, power (noun); possessive -tü, 'strong, having strength' (noun + possessive suffix, front-vowel form) [氣力 有的]
glossary.omoγtu: omoγ — bravery, pride, valour (noun); possessive -tu, 'brave, having bravery' (noun + possessive suffix, back-vowel form) [勇有的]
glossary.kürülčeküi: kürülče- — to meet, come together (from kür- 'reach'; reciprocal -lče-); participle -küi, 'the meeting' (verb, participle) [到的]
glossary.alalduqui: ala- — to kill; reciprocal -ldu-, participle -qui, 'the killing each other' (verb, reciprocal participle) [相殺︀的]
glossary.omogi: omoγ — bravery, pride; (i) Shiratori's linking vowel before the reflexive jan, 'one's own bravery' (noun + linking vowel; accusative reading uncertain) [勇自的行]
glossary.talbituγai: talbi- — to let go, put down, leave; optative -tuγai, 'let him leave' (verb, optative) [放了者︀]
glossary.kürülčen: kürülče- — to meet, come together; converb -n, 'meeting' (verb, converb) [相到]
glossary.üžeġülüleġe: üže- — to see; causative -ġül-, past -leġe (as in büleġe), 'showed, caused to see' (verb, causative, past) [敎見來]
glossary.jadamu: jada- — to be unable, fail; present -mu, 'is unable, fails' (verb, present) [不能有]
glossary.jadaqui-ji: jada- — to be unable, fail; participle -qui, 'the one who fails'; accusative -ji, object (verb, participle + case) [不能的行]
glossary.medegsen: mede- — to know; past participle -gsen, 'having known' (verb, past participle) [知道了]
glossary.kürbesü-ji: Kürbesü — Kürbesü, a woman's name (Tayang's mother); accusative -ji, object (personal name + case) [母名 行]
glossary.žasaγ̇ulqu: žasa- — to order, put in order, govern; causative -γul-, participle -qu, 'one who will have things ordered' (verb, causative participle) [敎整治]
glossary.čima: či — you; čima, the oblique stem (the accusative is čima-ji), 'you'; here the Ming takes it as an exclamation (pronoun; uncertain) [嘆聲]
glossary.ötöldeküi: ötöl- — to grow old (stem uncertain); -de- ending uncertain; participle -küi, 'who has grown old' (verb, participle; uncertain) [被老了]
glossary.čerig-ün: čerig — soldier, army (noun); genitive -ün, 'of the army' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [軍的]
glossary.žasal: žasal — rule, regulation, order, discipline (noun, from žasa- 'to order') [法度]
glossary.sülberküi: sülber- — to be slack, lax, negligent (stem uncertain); participle -küi, 'slackness, being slack' (verb, participle) [怠慢]
glossary.turluγ: turluγ — sense unknown; the Ming gives no gloss; it stands beside Tayang like an epithet (word, uncertain) []
glossary.buruγ̇u: buruγu — sense uncertain; the Ming gives a single character, 𠮠, which cannot be read (word, uncertain) [𠮠]
glossary.ükükü: ükü- — to die (stem inferred from the Ming); participle -kü, 'the one that dies, dying' (verb, participle) [死的]
glossary.žoboqu: žobo- — to toil, suffer (Ming 辛苦); participle -qu, 'the one that toils, the toiling' (verb, participle; stem inferred) [辛苦的]
glossary.usun-ača: usun — water, river; ablative -ača, 'from, along' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [水行]
glossary.tamir: Tamir — the Tamir, a river (river name) [水名]
glossary.orqon-i: Orqon — the Orqon, a river; accusative -i, marks the object (river name + case) [河名行]
glossary.naqu: Naqu — Naqu, a mountain name (place name; the Ming gives only 山名 'mountain name') [山名]
glossary.qormai: qormai — skirt, hem; of a mountain, its foot (noun; Ming 裙 'skirt') [裙]
glossary.čakirmaγ̇ud: Čakirmaγ̇ud — Chakirma'ud, a place name (place name; the Ming gives only 地名) [地名]
glossary.kürgeġesü: kürge- — to bring to, deliver (kür- 'reach' made causative; uncertain); conditional -ġesü, 'if (one) brings to' (verb, conditional, front-vowel form) [送到呵]
glossary.bolumn-že: bol- — to become, be; present ending -umn (shape uncertain) + assertion particle -že, 'indeed' (verb + particle) [做有 也者︀]
glossary.žasarun: žasa- — to arrange, put in order; converb of time -run, 'when arranging' (verb, converb) [整治時]
glossary.qaraγana: qaraγana — thicket, clump (noun; Ming 叢草般 'like a clump of grass'; stem uncertain) [叢草般]
glossary.jorčil: jorči- — to go, set out (verb stem; stem inferred from Ming 行); -l, verbal ending of uncertain force (verb; uncertain) [行]
glossary.baildu: bai- — to stand; reciprocal -ldu-, 'one another' (verb; the Ming 陣 'battle line' points to a noun sense, 'the standing-off, array'; uncertain) [陣]
glossary.šiγ̇uči: šiγ̇uči — chisel (noun; Ming 鑿子般 'chisel-like') [鑿子般]
glossary.qadqulduγ̇a: qadqu- — to fight, strike; reciprocal -ldu-, 'one another'; -γ̇a, ending of uncertain force (optative or nominal) (verb; uncertain) [厮殺︀]
glossary.žasaγ̇ulba: žasa- — to arrange, put in order; causative -γ̇ul-, 'cause to'; past -ba, '-ed' (verb, causative, past) [敎整治了]
glossary.nojan-i: nojan — lord, commander (noun); accusative -i, marks the object (noun + case) [官人行]
glossary.kötöd: kötö — a led horse, one that follows on the lead (stem uncertain; compare kötöl 'led, following' in the glossary; Ming 從馬 'following horses'); plural -d, 'led horses' (noun + plural; uncertain) [從馬(每)]
glossary.čakirmaγ̇ud-ača: Čakirmaγ̇ud — Chakirma'ud, a place name; ablative -ača, 'from, at' (place name + case, back-vowel form) [地名處]
glossary.aγ̇ula-jin: aγ̇ula — mountain; genitive -jin, 'of' (after a vowel) (noun + case) [山 的]
glossary.kižin: kižin — along, alongside (postposition or adverb; Ming 緣着 'following along'; uncertain) [緣着]
glossary.neiletele: neile- — to join, come together; terminal converb -tele, 'right up to, until' (verb, converb; Ming 相合) [相合]
glossary.kürküi-ji: kür- — to reach, arrive; participle -küi, 'the one that reaches'; accusative -ji, after a vowel (verb, participle + case) [到的 行]
glossary.naiman-luγ̇a: Naiman — the Naiman, a people; comitative -luγ̇a, 'together with' (people name + case; Ming 種名 'name of a kind' + 一同 'together') [種名 一同]
glossary.ireldüžü: ire- — to come; reciprocal -ldü-, 'together'; converb -žü, 'coming together' (verb, reciprocal, converb, front-vowel form) [共來着]
glossary.jaγ̇ud: jaγ̇ud — what, whichever, all sorts of; plural (pronoun, plural; Ming 甚麽每; uncertain) [甚麽每]
glossary.qoton-dur: qoton — enclosure, pen, yard (noun; Ming 圈子); dative-locative -dur, 'in, at' (noun + case) [圈子 裏]
glossary.noγais-i: noγai — dog (noun); plural -s; accusative -i, marks the object (noun + plural + case) [狗(每)行]
glossary.miqa-γ̇ar: miqa — meat, flesh (noun); instrumental -γ̇ar, 'with, by means of' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [肉敎]
glossary.težiġežü: težiġe- — to feed, rear (Ming 養); converb -žü, 'feeding' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [養着]
glossary.ginžiležü: ginži — iron chain (Ming 鐵索); verb-forming -le-, 'to chain'; converb -žü, 'chaining' (noun + verb-former + converb) [鐵索]
glossary.širemün: širemün — raw copper (noun; Ming 生銅 'raw copper') [生銅]
glossary.maṅlaitan: maṅlai — forehead (noun; Ming 額顱); possessive plural -tan, 'those having' (noun + possessive plural; written with a dotted ṅ) [額顱有的(每)]
glossary.qošiγ̇utan: qošiγ̇u — beak, muzzle (noun; Ming 觜); possessive plural -tan, 'those having' (noun + possessive plural) [觜 有的(每)]
glossary.šibüge: šibüge — awl, bodkin (noun; Ming 錐子 'awl') [錐子]
glossary.keleten: kele — tongue (noun); possessive plural -ten, 'those having' (noun + possessive plural, front-vowel form) [舌 有的(每)]
glossary.öreten: öre — heart (noun; stem inferred from the Ming 心); possessive plural -ten, 'those having' (noun + possessive plural, front-vowel form) [心有的(每)]
glossary.minaγ̇atan: minaγ̇a — whip (noun; Ming 做鞭 'made as a whip'); possessive plural -tan, 'those having' (noun + possessive plural) [做鞭 有的(每)]
glossary.šiġüderi: šiġüder — dew (noun; Ming 露; stem uncertain); accusative -i (noun + case; uncertain) [露]
glossary.jabud: jabu- — to go; plural -d, 'those who go' (verb, plural participle) [行每]
glossary.ided: ide- — to eat; plural -d, 'those who eat' (verb, plural participle) [喫每]
glossary.kürülčekü: kürülče- — to meet, come together (from kür- 'reach'; reciprocal -lče-, here written -ülče-; Ming 相到); participle -kü, 'the meeting, the one that meets' (verb, reciprocal, participle; uncertain) [相到的]
glossary.künesüled: künesü — provisions for a journey (Ming 行糧 'marching grain'); verb-forming -le-, 'make into'; plural -d, 'those who do' (noun + verb-former + plural) [做行糧]
glossary.ginži-ben: ginži — iron chain (Ming 鐵索); reflexive-possessive -ben, 'one's own' (front-vowel form, after a vowel) (noun + reflexive) [鐵索自的行]
glossary.mültüldežü: mültülde- — to slip free, be pulled off (stem inferred from the Ming 被脫); converb -žü, 'being pulled off' (verb, converb) [被脫着]
glossary.buγsažu: buγsa- — to restrain, tie up (Ming 拘束 'to bind, hold in'); converb -žu, 'restraining' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [拘束着]
glossary.šilemelčen: šilemelče- — to drool, to covet (Ming 垂涎 'to slaver'); converb -n, 'drooling' (verb, converb) [垂涎着]
glossary.doromži-ača: doromži — lowly, inferior (Ming 下等 'low grade'); ablative -ača, 'from' (adjective + case; uncertain; once with the plural, Ming 下等每 行) [下等 處]

glossary.samaγ̇uraqu: samaγ̇ura- — to be in disorder, to run wild (Ming 亂了); participle -qu (future or habitual), 'will …' (verb, participle, back-vowel form) [亂了]
glossary.qatun-luγ̇a: qatun — lady, queen, wife of a khan; comitative -luγ̇a, 'with the lady' (noun + case, back-vowel form; Ming 一同) [娘子 一同]
glossary.najā-ji: Najā — Naya'a, a man's name (short writing of Najaγ̇a); accusative -ji after a vowel, 'Naya'a (object)' (personal name + case; Ming 行) [人名行]
glossary.tödeġežü: tödeġe- — to stop, to hold up (stem inferred from the Ming 止當着; perhaps related to töridġe-); converb -žü, 'holding up' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [止當着]
glossary.qataṅγuj-a: qataṅγuj — hard, stern, unyielding (Ming 剛硬; form uncertain); dative-locative -a used adverbially, 'with sternness' (adjective + case, back-vowel form; Ming 行) [剛硬 行]
glossary.maraγ̇an: maraγ̇an — closely, minutely (adverb; Ming 仔細) [仔細]
glossary.asaγču: asaγ- — to ask; converb -ču, 'asking' (verb, converb) [問着]
glossary.idγaluγ̇a: idγa- — to urge, to persuade (stem inferred from the Ming 勸); past -luγ̇a (as -laγ̇a; Ming 來), 'urged' (verb, past, back-vowel form) [勸來]
glossary.najaγ̇a-dāča: Najaγ̇a — Naya'a, a man's name; ablative -dāča with a long vowel, 'from, other than' (personal name + case, back-vowel form; the Ming 處 marks 'at the place of') [(人)名處]
glossary.čeriġüd-tür: čeri — army, soldiers; plural -ġüd; dative-locative -tür, 'to the soldiers' (noun + plural + case, front-vowel form; Ming 行) [軍每行]
glossary.samaγ̇u-dur: samaγ̇u — disorder, confusion (noun; Ming 亂); dative-locative -dur, 'in disorder' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [亂裏]
glossary.čeküi-dür: čeküi — raw, unripe, unfamiliar (Ming 生; sense and form uncertain); dative-locative -dür, 'in …' (noun or adjective + case, front-vowel form) [生裏]
glossary.oroqu-ju: oro- — to enter; participle -qu (future or habitual); -ju, an ending 'is' (Ming 有; as in bi-jü; uncertain) (verb, participle + ending) [入去有]
glossary.γai: γai — I wonder, who knows (particle; Ming 不知 'not known') [不知]
glossary.najaγ̇a-dur: Najaγ̇a — Naya'a, a man's name; dative-locative -dur, 'at, to Naya'a' (personal name + case, back-vowel form; Ming 行) [人名 行]
glossary.učiraqui: učira- — to meet, to chance upon; participle -qui, 'that which meets, the meeting' (verb, participle; Ming 的) [遇着的]
glossary.asaγtala: asaγ- — to ask; -tala, 'while, until', 'while asking' (verb, converb; Ming 間) [問間]
glossary.teṅgeri-jin: teṅgeri — Heaven, the sky as a power; genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of Heaven' (noun + case; Ming 的) [天 的]
glossary.žajaγ̇a-γ̇ar: žajaγ̇a — destiny, fate allotted; instrumental -γ̇ar, 'by, through' (noun + case, back-vowel form; Ming 裏) [命 裏]
glossary.töreġülügsen: töre- — to be born; causative -ġül-, 'to bring to birth, bear'; past participle -ügsen (-gsen with a linking vowel), 'that which bore' (verb, causative participle) [生了的]
glossary.marijan: marijan — skin (noun; Ming 皮膚; the token left before -(n)ača) [皮膚 行]
glossary.öčiġülžüġüi: öči- — to speak up, to report to a superior (stem inferred from the Ming 奏); causative -ġül-, 'have reported'; past -žüġüi (verb, causative past, front-vowel form) [敎奏了]
glossary.asaγdarun: asaγ- — to ask; passive -da-, converb of time -run, 'when asked' (verb, passive converb) [被問時]
glossary.nu-γ̇an: -(n)u-γ̇an — genitive -(n)u (the token left after Qaγan-(n)-; the (n) is Shiratori's) + reflexive-possessive -γ̇an, 'of one's own qan' (case + reflexive-possessive, back-vowel form; Ming 自的行) [皇帝 自的行]
glossary.amu-že: a- — to be; -mu, present ending 'is' (as in amui; uncertain); -že, assertion particle 'indeed, surely' (verb + particle; Ming 也者) [有 也者︀]
glossary.öčil: öčil — report, petition, what is said up to a superior (noun; Ming 奏事) [奏事]
glossary.soriγ̇asu: sori- — to test, to try (stem inferred from the Ming 試); conditional -γ̇asu, 'if, when' (verb, conditional, back-vowel form; Ming 呵) [試呵]
glossary.taγ̇alaba: taγ̇ala- — to love (Ming 愛); past -ba, 'loved' (verb, past) [愛了]
glossary.ügetü: üge — word, speech; possessive -tü, 'having words, of word' (noun + possessive, front-vowel form; Ming 言語有的) [言語有的]
glossary.üile: üile — matter, business, task (noun; Ming 勾當) [勾當]
glossary.tüšišü: tüši- — to entrust, to appoint (stem inferred from the Ming 委付); optative first person -šü, 'let me entrust' (verb, optative, front-vowel form) [委付]
